qe: Which of the following is often called the 'Barometer' of the Indian Economy?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे अक्सर भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था का 'बैरोमीटर' कहा जाता है?
e: Bhartiya arthavyavastha ka barometer aksar Sensex ko kaha jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai; yah BSE ka index hai jo 30 badi companyon ke share ka badhta-girta aankda dikhata hai. Ise barometer isliye kaha jaata hai ki jab desh ka karobar, nivesh tatha kharid tez hoti hai to companyon ka munafa badhta hai tatha Sensex pehle hi upar chala jaata hai; isliye log ise poore karobar ka mausam naapne wala yantra maankar dekhte hain. Exchange Rate, Repo Rate tatha GDP Growth Rate bhi ahem aankde hain par ye aarthik niti ke sadhan ya natije hain, barometer nahi, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Sensex hi bhartiya arthavyavastha ka barometer kaha jaata hai - yahi BSE ke 30 bade share ka index hai.

qe: What is 'Arbitrage' in the context of stock markets?
qh: शेयर बाजारों के संदर्भ में 'आर्बिट्राज' (Arbitrage) क्या है?
o: Simultaneous purchase and sale to profit from price difference
e: Arbitrage ka matlab hai ek hi cheez ko ek bazaar mein sasta kharid kar doosre bazaar mein turant mehanga bech dena, isliye ek saath kharid-farokht wala vikalp sahi hai. Yah upay isliye kaam karta hai ki ek hi share ke daam alag-alag bazaar mein kuchh pal ke liye alag ho jaate hain; isliye bade tarak karne wale computer sehans hi dono jagah order lagakar dono ke dam ka farq bina jokhim kama lete hain tatha isi karan dono bazaar ke dam ek jaise ho jaate hain. Unche dam par kharidna, juwa tatha lambi avadhi ka nivesh arbitrage nahi hain, kyonki yah teeno jokhim uthaate hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Arbitrage mein ek hi cheez ek bazaar mein kharid kar doosre mein turant bech di jaati hai - isse bina jokhim farq kamaate hain.

qe: What is a 'Circuit Breaker' in stock trading?
qh: स्टॉक ट्रेडिंग में 'सर्किट ब्रेकर' क्या है?
o: Automatic stop in trading when prices fluctuate beyond a limit
e: Circuit Breaker trading rokne ki ek suraksha vyavastha hai jo daam seema se zyada girne ya badhne par khud chalu ho jaati hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah bandobast isliye kiya gaya ki ek hi din mein sunaami ki tarah share bikne se chhoti niveshko ka paisa poori tarah khatam na ho jaye; isliye seema cross hone par 15 minute, 45 minute ya poore din ke liye bazaaron mein taala lag jaata hai tatha SENSEX tatha NIFTY dono par yah niyam lagta hai. Share ka prakar, bijli ka dosh tatha broker ka commission is shabd ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno sahi nahi baithte. Exam point: Circuit Breaker daam ke jhatke par bazaar rokne ka automatic taala hai - yahi chhote niveshko ko bachata hai.

qe: What are 'Participatory Notes' (P-Notes)?
o: Instruments used by foreign investors not registered with SEBI
e: Particapatory Notes (P-Notes) ve kagaz hain jinse videshi niveshak bharat ke bazaar mein paisa lagate hain bina SEBI ke saath khud panjikrit hue, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah tarika isliye chuna jaata hai ki videshi niveshak ko panjikaran ki lambi prakriya tatha kagaz-patra nahi karna padta; isliye woh kisi panjikrit broker ke zariye derivate tatha share kharidta hai tatha asli niveshak ka naam khojna aasan nahi hota, isi karan inhe kaale dhan ke istemal ka shak bana rehta hai. RBI ke note, kampani ke karz ke kagaz tatha mudra ke note P-Notes nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: P-Notes bina panjikrit videshi nivesh ka raasta hain - isliye inki nigrani par kadi nazar rakhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the 'Face Value' of a share?
qh: शेयर का 'फेस वैल्यू' (Face Value) क्या है?
o: Price mentioned on the share certificate
e: Share ka Face Value wo keemat hai jo share ke praman-patra par likhi hoti hai tatha company ne shuru mein yahi keemat tay ki thi, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai; aam share ka face value das rupaye hota hai. Yah saankhya isliye mahatvapurn hai ki company labh baantne tatha naye share nikaalne ke faisle isi aadhar par karti hai; isliye market mein share ka dam chahe sau rupaye ho ya pachaas, face value wahi das rupaye rehta hai. Saalana ausat dam, market ka dam tatha bazaari bikri ka dam vyavahar ke aankde hain, face value nahi, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Exam point: Face value share ke praman-patra par likhi keemat hoti hai - bazaar ka dam isse alag badhta-girta rehta hai.

qe: Which of the following is an Indian independent 'Credit Rating Agency'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत में एक 'क्रेडिट रेटिंग एजेंसी' है?
e: Credit Rating Agency wo sanstha hai jo karz lene wale desh ya company ki wapas karne ki shamta ko aankati hai; bharat mein ICRA aisi hi ek sanstha hai, isliye yahi sahi naam hai. Yah sanstha isliye mahatvapurn hai ki niveshko apna paisa lagane se pehle jaanna chahte hain ki wapasi ka kya jokhim hai, isliye unki di hui rating se byaj ki dar tatha karz ke daam tay hote hain. NITI Aayog niti banane wali sarkari sanstha hai, CII tatha FICCI udyogon ke sangathan hain, isliye ye teeno is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain. Exam point: ICRA bharat ki credit rating agency hai - yahi karz lene wale ki wapasi ki shamta naapti hai.

qe: What does 'LTV' stand for in lending?
qh: ऋण (Lending) के संदर्भ में 'LTV' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: LTV yani Loan to Value ka matlab hai lending (karz) ki rakam tatha girvi rakhi gayi sampatti ke dam ka anupaat, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah anupaat isliye dekha jaata hai ki bank aise bina zyada jokhim ke paisa de sake; isliye ghar ka dam sau rupaye ho tatha LTV assi pratishat rakha jaye to bank adhiktam assi rupaye tak ka hi karz dega tatha baaki paisa khud lagana padega. Late Tax Value, Long Term Value tatha Lower Tier Volume kasut ke ye shabd nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: LTV karz tatha sampatti ke dam ka anupaat hota hai - isse bank apna karz jokhim seemit rakhta hai.

qe: What is an 'ETF'?
e: ETF yani Exchange Traded Fund aisa kosh hai jiske shares bazaar mein aam share ki tarah din bhar kharide-beche ja sakte hain, isliye yahi sahi naam hai. Yah kosh isliye lokpriya hai ki ismein alag-alag share chunne ki zarurat nahi; isliye ek hi share kharid kar poore index jaise Sensex ya sauna jaise sona chandni prapt ki ja sakti hai tatha kharcha bhi kam lagta hai. Equity Trust Fund, Electronic Transfer Fund tatha Easy Tax Fund shabd sunne mein milte-julte hain par ETF ke poore naam nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ETF Exchange Traded Fund hai - yahi index ya sona mehnge daam bina kharida ja sakta hai.

qe: What is a 'Commercial Bill' in the money market?
qh: मुद्रा बाजार में 'कमर्शियल बिल' (Commercial Bill) क्या है?
o: A bill of exchange used to finance the working capital of firms
e: Commercial Bill yani vyaparik bill aisa kagaz hota hai jise karobar apni rozmarra ki zarurat (working capital) ke liye vyapar karne wale kagaz par chhootkar paisa jutane ke liye likhta hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah bill isliye kaam aata hai ki maal bechne ke baad paisa kuchh mahine se zyada baad aata hai tatha us beech factory chalane ke liye paisa chahiye hota hai; isliye bill ko bina-kaat ya kuchh kaat kar bank ya vaapas dene wale ko bech diya jaata hai tatha asli bhugtan hone par aakhri bhar wapas mil jaata hai. Share ka praman-patra, kar ka invoice tatha sarkari karz is bill ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Commercial Bill vyaparik kaam ki punji ke liye istemal hone wala bill of exchange hota hai.

qe: What is the standard 'Settlement Cycle' for most equity shares in India?
qh: भारत में अधिकांश शेयरों के लिए 'सेटलमेंट साइकिल' (Settlement Cycle) क्या है?
e: Aaj bharat mein adhiktam sharevan ke liye Settlement Cycle T+1 hai, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai; yani saude ke din (T) ke agle karobar din hi paisa tatha share apni jagah pahunch jaate hain. Yah badlav isliye hua ki pehle T+2 chal raha tha tatha usmein paisa tatha share do din latak jaate the, isse jokhim tatha kaam badhta tha; isliye SEBI ne 2023 se T+1 laagu kiya tatha kuchh sharevan par T+0 ka praikshalan bhi chala, jo bharat ko pehla desh bana gaya. T+10 tatha T+5 bahut purane chalan the, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: bharat mein aam taur par settlement T+1 par hota hai - yani agle karobar din tak paisa aur share mil jaate hain.

qe: What is 'Short Selling' in stock market terms?
qh: शेयर बाजार की शर्तों में 'शॉर्ट सेलिंग' (Short Selling) क्या है?
o: Selling borrowed shares in hope of buying them back cheaper
e: Short selling ka matlab hai udhar liye gaye share bech dena tatha sahaara lagakar ushe sasta hokar wapas kharidkar udhar chukana, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah chalan isliye kaam karta hai ki trader ko lagta hai daam girega, isliye woh upar bech kar neeche kharidta hai tatha dono dam ka farq uska munafa rehta hai; par agar daam ulat badh jaaye to uska nuksan aseemit ho sakta hai, isliye bharat mein institutional short selling ko chhoot aur suraksha ke niyam se baandha gaya hai. Apne share bechna, chhot naampo par bechna tatha paanch minute mein bech dena short selling nahi hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Short selling mein udhar ke share bechkar sasta hokar wapas kharidna hai - yahi girte bazaar se kamane ka tarika hai.

qe: What is the 'Call Money' rate?
qh: 'कॉल मनी' दर (Call Money Rate) क्या है?
o: Interest rate for inter-bank overnight lending
Interest rate for long term loans
e: Call Money Rate aisi byaj dar ko kaha jaata hai jis par bank ek doosre se ek din ke liye paisa udhar lete hain, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah dar isliye ahem hai ki bankon ko roz apne grahak ke withdraw tatha Reserve Bank ke niyam poore karne ke liye paisa chahiye hota hai; isliye jis bank ke paas zyada paisa ho woh keval ek din ke liye udhar deta hai tatha is dar se turant pata chal jaata hai ki star par paisa kitna hai ya kam. Fixed deposit ki dar, lambi avadhi ke karz ki dar tatha labhansh ki dar is dar ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Call Money Rate ek din ke liye bankon ke aapasi udhar ki dar hai - yahi mudra star kee kadi dikhati hai.

qe: Who is the primary regulator of Commodity Derivative Markets in India?
qh: भारत में कमोडिटी मार्केट (जैसे सोना, तेल) का नियामक कौन है?
e: Bharat mein commodity market yani sone, tel tatha anaaj ke bazaar ka niyamak SEBI hai, isliye yahi sahi naam hai. Yah vyavastha isliye bani ki pehle Forward Markets Commission (FMC) yah kaam dekhta tha, par 2015 mein ushe SEBI ke saath mila diya gaya tatha aaj SEBI share tatha commodity dono bazaaron par nazar rakhti hai. FMC ab khatam ho chuki hai, Krishi Mantralaya keval kheti ki niti banata hai tatha RBI bankon tatha mudra par nazar rakhta hai, isliye ye teeno is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain. Exam point: commodity market ka niyamak SEBI hai - 2015 mein FMC isi ke saath mila di gayi thi.

qe: What are 'Masala Bonds'?
o: Rupee-denominated bonds issued by Indian entities in foreign markets
e: Masala Bonds ve bandhan (bonds) hain jo bharatiya sansthaen videsh mein jaakar rupaye mein nikaalti hain, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Inhe masala naam isliye mila ki 2015 se pehle bharat ke bahar rupaye mein karz lena mushkil tha, isliye IFC ne pehla aisa bond nikaalkar bharat ke masalon ki yaad dilai; isliye in par videshi mudra ke badlav ka jokhim niveshak par rehta hai tatha bharatiya sanstha par nahi. Gaon mein nikaale bond, khane-peene ki companyon ke bond tatha high risk junk bond ko is naam se nahi jaana jaata, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Masala Bonds rupaye mein videsh mein nikaale jaane wale bond hain - ismein mudra ka jokhim niveshak par hota hai.

qe: What is 'Beta' in the context of stock volatility?
qh: स्टॉक की अस्थिरता के संदर्भ में 'बीटा' (Beta) क्या है?
o: Measure of a stock's sensitivity to market movements
e: Beta aankda batata hai ki kisi share ka daam poore bazaar ke badlav ke saath kitna hilta hai, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Beta isliye dekha jaata hai ki niveshak ko pata chale ki uska share bazaar ke saath tez hilta hai ya dheere; isliye agar bazaar ek pratishat badhe tatha share ka beta do ho to woh saadhaaran se dugna hilne ki umeed rakhta hai tatha beta ek se kam ho to share bazaar se dheere hilt a hai. Labhansh ki dar, share ki kul sankhya tatha munafa ka hissa Beta ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Beta share ki bazaar ke badlav ke prati sanvedansheelta naapta hai - isse niveshka jokhim samajh mein aata hai.

qe: Which of these is a 'Leading Indicator' of an economy?
qh: इनमें से कौन अर्थव्यवस्था का एक 'अग्रणी संकेतक' (Leading Indicator) है?
e: Agrani sanket (Leading Indicator) wo aankda hota hai jo poore karobar ke badlav se pehle hi ishara de deta hai; Stock Market Index aisa hi sanket hai, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai. Share ke dam isliye pehle badalte hain ki niveshka companyon ke munafa tatha aage ke kaam ki umeed par pehle hi kharid ya bikri karte hain; isliye bazaar ka index badhna batata hai ki kuchh mahinon baad udyog, rozgaar tatha hrik kaisi rahegi. GDP, mehngai tatha berozgari ke aankde der se aate hain tatha peeche dekhkar batate hain, isliye ye teeno is shreni ke nahi hain. Exam point: Stock Market Index ek agrani sanket hai - yahi karobar ke aage ke rukh ka ishara deta hai.

qe: What is 'Liquidity' in financial terms?
o: Ease with which an asset can be converted into cash
e: Liquidity ka matlab hai kisi sampatti ko kitni aasaani tatha jaldi bina daam kam kiye nakad (cash) mein badla ja sakta hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah baat isliye ahem hai ki company tatha bank ko roz ke bhugtan ke liye nakad chahiye hota hai; isliye bank ke paas nakad anupat kam ho jaye to sankat khada ho jaata hai tatha isi karan sankat ke samay Reserve Bank bazaar mein paisa daalti hai. Company ke karz ka anupaat, share ke daam ka badhna tatha zyada paisa is shabd ke matlab nahi hain, isliye inhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: Liquidity sampatti ko nakad mein badalne ki sahajta hai - kam liquidity sankat ka bada karan hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Promoter's Stake' in a company?
qh: किसी कंपनी में 'प्रमोटर की हिस्सेदारी' (Promoter's Stake) क्या है?
o: Shares held by the founders or controlling owners
Shares held by the general public
e: Promoter's Stake yani promoter ka hissa woh share hote hain jo company ke shuruat karne wale tatha ushe chalane wale maalik ke paas hote hain, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah sankhya isliye dekhi jaati hai ki promoter ka apne karobar par kitna bharosa hai, iska pata chale; isliye agar promoter apne share girvi rakhkar paisa jutaata hai ya bech deta hai to bazaar ushe kharab ishara maanta hai, tatha upar ke niyam ke hisaab se unhe bharat mein kam se kam 25 pratishat share aam logon ke paas rakhna padta hai. Videshi niveshka, sarkar tatha aam janta ke paas rakhe share apne-apne naam se jaane jaate hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: promoter ke hisse se bazaar maalik ke bharose ka pata lagata hai - isliye usmein badlav par nazar rakhi jaati hai.

qe: What does 'T-plus-Zero' (T+0) settlement mean?
e: T+0 ka matlab hai saude tatha bhugtan dono ek hi din mein poora ho jaana, isliye same day wala vikalp sahi hai. Yah vyavastha isliye laayi ja rahi hai ki T+1 mein bhi raat bhar paisa tatha share latak jaate hain tatha broker ke paas girvi tatha jokhim rehta hai; isliye 2024 mein SEBI ne kuchh sharevan par optional T+0 settlement shuru kiya, jismein bazaar band hone se pehle hi share tatha paisa palat jaate hain. Weekly, no settlement tatha next day wale vikalp iske matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Exam point: T+0 se same day settlement hota hai - yahi bharat ki sabse tez settlement vyavastha hai.

qe: What is an 'Angel Investor'?
o: A private individual providing capital for a business start-up
e: Angel Investor aisa niji vyakti hota hai jo naye karobar ko shuruat ke samay apna paisa tatha anubhav dekar khada karne mein madad karta hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah niveshka isliye aage aata hai ki naye kaam ko shuruat mein bank karz dene se katrate hain; isliye woh badle mein company mein hissa leta hai tatha apna anubhav, rishte tatha salaah bhi deta hai, isliye uska jokhim bhi zyada hota hai. Sarkari egency, bank manager tatha stock broker apne kaam ke hisaab se alag bhumika rakhte hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Angel Investor niji paisa lagane wala shuruati madadgaar hota hai - yahi naye karobar ko shuru mein sahara deta hai.

qe: Which exchange manages the 'Sensex' index?
qh: 'सेंसेक्स' इंडेक्स का प्रबंधन कौन करता है?
e: BSE tatha NSE dono apne index ka prabandhan karte hain; Sensex BSE ka index hai, isliye iska prabandhan BSE karta hai. Yah index kaam isliye kiya jaata hai ki poore bazaar ka rukh ek hi aankde mein dikhaya ja sake; isliye BSE har samay 30 chuni hui badi companyon ke share ka jod laga kar ushe free-float method se jodta-hisab lagata hai tatha 1986 se yah index chal raha hai. RBI bankon ka niyamak hai, NSE apna Nifty chaalata hai tatha SEBI poore bazaar ka niyamak hai, isliye ye teeno Sensex ke prabandhak nahi hain. Exam point: Sensex ka prabandhan BSE karta hai - yahi 30 bade share ka purana tatha prasiddh index hai.

qe: What is 'Yield' in bond market terminology?
qh: बॉन्ड बाजार की शब्दावली में 'यील्ड' (Yield) क्या है?
o: The return an investor realizes on a bond
e: Yield ka matlab hai bond par niveshka ko milne wala wapasi ka labh, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah aankda isliye ahem hai ki bond ka daam tatha uski yield ulat chalte hain; isliye jab bazaar mein bond ka daam girta hai to purane bond ki yield badh jaati hai tatha sarkar ko naya karz lene par zyada byaj dena padta hai. Bond ki avadhi, bond ka face value tatha bond par lagne wala kar Yield ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Yield bond par milne wala labh hai - bond ka daam girne par yield badh jaati hai.

qe: What is an 'FPO' in the stock market?
e: FPO yani Follow-on Public Offer ka matlab hai kisi aisi company ka naya share nikaalna jo pehle hi ek baar share nikaal chuki hai, isliye yahi sahi naam hai. Yah rasta isliye istemal hota hai ki badhti company ko naye kaam tatha karz chukane ke liye aur paisa chahiye; isliye woh apne purane share ke saath naye share bazaar mein nikaalti hai tatha purane niveshko ko bhi kuchh share aage rakhe jaate hain. Fixed Profit Offer, Foreign Public Offer tatha First Public Offer shabd sunne mein milte-julte hain par sahi poore naam nahi hain - pehli baar share nikaalne ko IPO kaha jaata hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: FPO us company ka share nikaalna hai jo pehle hi bazaar mein aa chuki hai - pehli baar nikaalne ko IPO kehte hain.

qe: What is the primary function of a 'Depository' (like NSDL/CDSL)?
e: Depository ki bhumika share tatha anya securities ko electronic roop mein rakhna hai, isliye yahi sahi kaam hai; NSDL tatha CDSL do aisi hi sansthaen hain. Yah vyavastha isliye laayi gayi ki pehle kagaz ke share chori hone, ghum hone tatha nakli banane ka bada jokhim tha; isliye aaj share ka asli maalik hona demat khate mein dikhta hai tatha transfer bina kagaz ke bina hi ho jaata hai. Karz dena, byaj ki dar tay karna tatha RBI ko niyamit karna depository ke kaam nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Depository securities ko electronic roop mein rakhti hai - isi karan demat khata zaroori hota hai.

qe: What is 'Proprietary Trading'?
o: A firm trading its own money for its own direct profit
e: Proprietary Trading ka matlab hai firm apne hi paise se apne munafa ke liye bazaar mein saude kare, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah chalan isliye apnaya jaata hai ki firm grahkon ke order chhod kar apni samajh par bade saude karke kamana chahti hai; par ismein jokhim bhi poori firm par aata hai, isliye 2008 ke sankat ke baad bade bankon ki aisi trading par kai deshon ne rok lagane ke niyam banaye. Grahak ke liye trading, sarkari sone ka karobar tatha nakli karobar Proprietary Trading nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Proprietary Trading firm ka apne paise se apne laabh ke liye karobar hota hai - ismein jokhim firm par hi rehta hai.

qe: What does 'Open Interest' represent in derivatives markets?
qh: डेरिवेटिव्स में 'ओपन इंटरेस्ट' (Open Interest) क्या है?
o: Total number of outstanding contracts not yet settled
e: Open Interest ka matlab hai bazaar mein abhi zinda tatha bina chukaye bache derivate contract ki kul sankhya, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Yah ginti isliye dekhi jaati hai ki pata chale niveshka ka jhukav kis taraf zyada hai; isliye daam badhne ke saath Open Interest bhi badhe to nayi kharid aayi hai, par daam badhne ke saath Open Interest gire to log apna sauda band kar kar chale gaye, isliye dono ka matlab ulat hota hai. Din ka kul munafa, karz par byaj tatha kharidaron ki sankhya Open Interest nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Open Interest bache derivate contract ki kul sankhya hai - daam ke saath iska badlav bazaar ka asli rukh batata hai.

qe: What is a 'Sovereign Rating'?
o: Credit rating of a private company
Credit rating of a sovereign country or national government
e: Sovereign Rating kisi desh ya uski sarkar ki karz wapas karne ki shamta ka aankda hota hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah rating isliye ahem hai ki isse tay hota hai ki sarkar tatha desh ke bankon ko videsh se karz kitni byaj par milega; isliye kharab rating wale deshon ko mehanga karz lena padta hai tatha videshi niveshka wahan paisa lagane se katrate hain. Niji company ki rating, commercial bank ki rating tatha sone ki shudhta ke aankde alag-alag cheezein hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Sovereign Rating desh ki karz chukane ki shamta ka aankda hai - isse uski videshi karz ki dar tay hoti hai.

qe: What is a 'Market Lot' in stock and derivative trading?
qh: स्टॉक ट्रेडिंग में 'मार्केट लॉट' (Market Lot) क्या है?
o: The maximum shares you can buy
The minimum standardized bundle of shares that can be traded
e: Market Lot ka matlab hai share ka wo sabse chhota pakka samuh jo bazaar mein ek saude mein kharida-beche ja sakta hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah isliye tay kiya gaya ki chhote-chhote saude se samay tatha kharcha bache; isliye ek lot mein ek tay sankhya ke share hote hain tatha niveshka ko usi gunj ki sankhya mein saude karne padte hain, halaanki share ke bazaar mein aaj kal aksar ek share ka lot chal raha hai. Adhiktam share ki seema, broker ka prakar tatha company ke kul share Market Lot ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Market Lot share ka sabse chhota pakka samuh hai - isi gunj mein bazaar par saude hote hain.

qe: What is the 'Dow Jones Industrial Average'?
o: US benchmark index tracking 30 prominent blue-chip companies
e: Dow Jones aisa soochak hai jo America ke bazaar ke 30 bade tatha purane share (blue-chip) ka aankda dikhata hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah soochak isliye mahatvapurn hai ki duniya ka sabse bada bazaar America ka hai, isliye wahan ka rukh anya deshon ke bazaar par bhi asar daalta hai; isliye ise dekhkar bharat ke bhi niveshka apne saude ke bare mein sochte hain. Japan, bharat tatha Britain ke apne-apne soochak Nikkei, Sensex tatha FTSE hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Dow Jones America ka benchmark index hai jo 30 badi companyon ko dekhta hai - yahi duniya ke bazaar ka purana soochak hai.

qe: What is a 'Lien' placed on shares?
o: Legal claim to hold possession of shares until an underlying debt is repaid
e: Lien ka matlab hai share par kanoonii pakad yani jab tak koi karz na chuk jaye woh share apne paas rakh lena, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah vyavastha isliye kaam aati hai ki bank ya broker share ko girvi rakhe bina apna paisa wapas lene ki suraksha chahta hai; isliye jab tak udhar wapas nahi hote, share bech ya hilaaye nahi ja sakte tatha chukane par pakad apne aap hat jaati hai. Share par voting, share ka tohfa tatha bade paman par share bech dena Lien nahi hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Lien share par kanoonii pakad hai - yahi karz chukne tak niveshka ka sauda rok deti hai.

qe: What is a 'Preference Share'?
o: Shares that receive dividend priority over equity shares
e: Preference Share ve share hote hain jinhe labh baantne mein aam equity share se pehle paisa milta hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah shreni isliye banai gayi ki kuchh niveshka ko badhte labh se zyada pakki aay chahiye hoti hai; isliye unhe pahle tay ki hui dar par labh milta hai tatha company band hone par paisa lutane mein bhi vaise hi pahle aate hain, par aam sadasya ki tarah poora mat nahi hota. Bina labh wale, keval sansthapakon ke paas wale tatha zyada matadhikar wale share is shreni ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Preference share ko labh tatha paisa wapas lutane mein pehla haq milta hai - unhe mat ka haq aam taur par nahi hota.

qe: What is 'Capital Gains Tax' (CGT)?
o: Tax on profit earned from selling capital assets like shares
e: Capital Gains Tax (CGT) aise munafa par lagne wala kar hai jo share ya anya sampatti bechne par milta hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah kar isliye lagta hai ki share kharid kar daam badhne par kamaai bahut zyada ho sakti hai tatha sarkar us par bhi apna hissa chahti hai; isliye bharat mein ek saal se pehle bechne par short-term tatha ek saal ke baad bechne par long-term capital gains tax lagta hai. Vetan par kar, company ki kamaai par kar tatha bank byaj par kar alag-alag kar hain, isliye ye teeno is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Capital Gains Tax share yaa sampatti bechne ke munafe par lagta hai - hold karne ki avadhi se uski dar tay hoti hai.

qe: What does a company's 'Debt-to-Equity' ratio measure?
o: Comparison of company's total debt to its total equity capital
e: Debt-to-Equity anupaat batata hai ki company ne karz tatha apne niveshak ke paise mein kitna-kitna lagaya hai, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Is anupaat se pata chalta hai ki zyada karz wali company par byaj chukane ka bojh bada hota hai tatha mandi mein woh jaldi doob sakti hai; isliye bank naya karz dene se pehle yah dekhta hai ki company ke apne paise kitne hain. Karz tatha bank ka anupaat, vetan tatha nivesh tatha munafa tatha kar ka anupaat isliye inhe is naam se nahi jaana jaata. Exam point: Debt-to-Equity anupaat company ke kul karz tatha apne niveshak ke paise ki tulna karta hai - kam anupaat aksar surakshit maana jaata hai.

qe: What does 'Haircut' mean when financial assets are pledged as collateral?
o: Percentage reduction in the stated value of an asset when used as collateral
e: Haircut ka matlab hai ki jab koi sampatti girvi rakhkar karz liya jaaye to uski likhit keemat mein kuchh pratishat kam kar liya jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah kaat isliye ki jaati hai ki girvi sampatti bechne par poora daam na mile; isliye sau rupaye ki keemat wali sampatti par 10 pratishat haircut lage to karz keval nabbe rupaye tak hi milta hai, aur sankat ke samay yah kaat badh jaati hai. Prabandhan mein badlav, broker ka munafa tatha vetan mein kami isliye ye teenon me se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: Haircut girvi sampatti ki keemat mein ki jaane wali pratishat kami hai - yahi karz dene wale ko suraksha deti hai.

qe: What are 'Junk Bonds'?
o: High-yield, high-risk bonds with sub-investment grade credit ratings
e: Junk Bonds ve bond hote hain jinhe kam-keemat wali (sub-investment grade) rating milti hai tatha jinhe paisa wapas na milne ka jokhim zyada hota hai, isliye unhe zyada byaj dena padta hai, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah bond isliye nikaale jaate hain ki naye ya kamzor company ko aam bond par niveshka bharosa nahi karte, isliye woh zyada byaj ka laalch dekar paisa jutaati hai; isi karan in par jokhim tatha munafa dono unche hote hain, par ye bekaar ya bina keemat ke bond nahi hote. Sarkari bond, bina kisi keemat ke bond tatha sone ke bond isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: Junk Bonds zyada byaj wale tatha zyada jokhim wale bond hote hain - inki rating sasta grade se neeche hoti hai.

qe: What is an 'NCD' (Non-Convertible Debenture)?
o: Debt that can be converted to shares
Fixed-income debt that cannot be converted into company equity shares
e: NCD yani Non-Convertible Debenture aisa karz hai jise company ke share mein badla nahi ja sakta, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah kagaz vyapar karne wali company jab bank se karz lene ke bajaye seedhe niveshka se paisa utaarna chahti hai tab nikaalti hai; isliye ismein ek tay muddat tatha tay byaj hota hai tatha muddat poore hone par paisa wapas milta hai. Sone ki jama, chhota bank karz tatha aisa karz jo share mein badal sake teeno alag cheezein hain - share mein badalne wale kagaz ko convertib le debenture kehte hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: NCD ve karz kagaz hain jo share mein nahi badalte - inmein pakka byaj tatha muddat hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Price to Earnings' (P/E) ratio?
o: Current share price divided by earnings per share
e: P/E anupaat yani Price to Earning batata hai ki bazaar mein share ka daam company ke ek share ke munafe ka kitna guna hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Iska istemal do companyon ki keemat ki tulna ke liye hota hai; isliye daam sau tatha per share munafa paanch ho to P/E bees hoga, jiska matlab hai niveshka bees saal ke munafe ke barabar daam de raha hai, isliye unch P/E par badhne ki umeed tatha khatra dono zyada hota hai. Kul aay tatha kar, munafa tatha karz tatha labh tatha daam ka anupaat isliye ye teeno is anupaat ke nahi hain. Exam point: P/E anupaat share ke daam ko per share munafe se bhaag deta hai - yah company mehangi hai ya sasti, iska aankda hai.

qe: Who is a 'Jobber' on a stock exchange floor?
qh: स्टॉक एक्सचेंज में 'जॉबर' (Jobber) कौन होता है?
o: A professional market maker who buys and sells securities on their own account
e: Jobber aisa peshewar vyakti hota hai jo share bazaar mein apne hi paise se apni marji par share kharidta tatha bechta hai, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah bhumika isliye zaroori hoti hai ki aam kharidne wale ko turant doosra pata na mile to bazaar ruk jaye; isliye jobber daam bata kar apne khatte se saude karta hai tatha kharid-tatha bikri ke daam mein chhota farq rakhkar kamata hai, par woh satta ka khel nahi karta, balki bazaar ka pahiya chalu rakhta hai. Sarkari adhikari, aam grahak tatha karz dene wala adhikari isliye ye teeno galat sabit hote hain. Exam point: Jobber apne khatte ke liye share kharid-beche karne wala peshewar vyakti hota hai - yahi bazaar mein daam ka pata deta hai.

qe: What is an 'Escrow Account'?
o: A temporary account held by a neutral third party until contractual obligations are met
e: Escrow Account aisa asthayi khata hota hai jise ek tatasth teesra paksh rakhta hai jab tak saude ki shartein poori na ho jaayein, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Bade saude jaise zameen kharidna tatha company ka adhigrahan mein dono paksh ko ek doosre par bharosa dilane ke liye yah raasta chuna jaata hai; isliye kharidne wala paisa us khatte mein daalta hai tatha maal naam palatne par hi bikri karne wale ko paisa milta hai. Zyada byaj wala khata, vyaktigat bachat khata tatha mishra jama isliye ye teeno is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Escrow Account tatasth paksh ke paas rakha asthayi khata hai - yahi bade saude mein dono paksh ko suraksha deta hai.

qe: What is 'ASIC' in global financial regulation?
qh: वैश्विक नियामक के संदर्भ में 'ASIC' क्या है?
e: ASIC yani Australian Securities and Investments Commission Australia ka bazaar niyamak hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah naam isliye poochha jaata hai ki har desh ka apna bazaar niyamak hota hai tatha videshi niveshko ke liye wahan ke niyam jaanna zaroori hota hai; isliye ASIC wahan share, bima tatha anya vitti sansthaon par nazar rakhta hai, thik usi tarah jaise bharat mein SEBI. Bhartiya niyamak, share ka prakar tatha computer ka saman isliye ye teeno alag cheezein hain. Exam point: ASIC Australia ka bazaar niyamak hai - yahi wahan ke niveshka tatha companyon par nazar rakhta hai.

qe: What is the 'Book Building' process in an IPO?
o: A price discovery mechanism where demand from investor bids determines offering price
e: Book Building aisi prakriya hai jismein badi niveshka se boli mangwa kar share ka daam tay kiya jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Yah tarika isliye istemal hota hai ki shuruati company ko khud pata nahi hota ki bazaar uske share ke kitne daam dega; isliye woh daam ki seema likh kar teen-chaar din tak boli mangwati hai tatha sabse zyada boli par kaafi share bike jaane ko dekhkar aakhri daam tay karta hai. Vitti kitab likhna, khate ka audit tatha library banaana isliye inhe is naam se nahi jaana jaata. Exam point: Book Building mein niveshka ki boli se share ka daam tay hota hai - yahi bazaar ki maang se daam khojne ka tarika hai.

qe: What is an 'Anchor Investor' in an Indian IPO?
qh: किसी IPO में 'एंकर निवेशक' (Anchor Investor) कौन है?
o: A Qualified Institutional Buyer applying for significant shares ahead of public issue opening
e: IPO mein anchor investor aisa bada sansthaik niveshak hota hai jo aam janta ke liye share khulne se pehle hi badi rakam ka share mang leta hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah vyavastha isliye banai gayi ki bade niveshak ka haath dekhkar aam log bhi company par bharosa karein; isliye anchor niveshak ko tay seema ke andar hi share milte hain tatha unhe kuchh samay tak bechna nahi hota, jisse daam girne se bacha jaye. Sarkari niyamak, chhota aam niveshak tatha bahkaane wala niveshak isliye ye teenon me se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: Anchor Investor bade sansthaik niveshak hote hain jo share khulne se pehle hi haath lagaate hain - yahi aam niveshka ko bharosa deta hai.

qe: What does 'Delisting' of a company mean?
o: Permanent removal of a company's listed securities from a stock exchange
e: Delisting ka matlab hai kisi company ke share ko share bazaar ki soochi se poore taur par hatana, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah kadam isliye uthta hai ki company ya to bazaar se poori tarah paisa kamane ki shartein poori nahi kar paati, ya phir use niji company banna hota hai; isliye soochi se naam hatne ke baad uske share kharid-beche nahi ja sakte tatha niveshka ko mauka diya jaata hai ki woh apne share ek tay daam par bech de. Company shuru karna, share bank ko bechna tatha naam badalna isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: Delisting share ko bazaar ki soochi se hamesha ke liye hata dena hai - iske baad us company ka karobar bazaar par nahi hota.

qe: What is an 'Over-the-Counter' (OTC) market?
o: Bilateral trading of financial instruments directly between parties without a centralized exchange
e: OTC yani over-the-counter bazaar aisa bazaar hai jahan do paksh bina kisi kendriya bazaar ke seedhe aapas mein sauda karte hain, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah tarika isliye chalta hai ki kuchh kagaz jaise mudra ka sauda tatha derivate itne bade ya naye hote hain ki unhe soochi par lana mushkil hota hai; isliye dealer phaune par boli laga kar daam tay karta hai tatha dono paksh ke beech seedha sauda hota hai, jisse daam har jagah alag ho sakta hai. Kar ka prakar, bazaar ke zariye karobar tatha dukaan mein karobar inhe is shabd se nahi joda jaata. Exam point: OTC bazaar mein sauda seedha do pakshon ke beech hota hai - ismein koi kendriya exchange nahi hota.

qe: What is 'Slippage' in financial trading?
o: Difference between the expected order price and the price at which the trade executes
e: Slippage ka matlab hai wo farq jo aap ke saude ke sochhe hue daam tatha haath lagne wale daam mein pad jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi roop hai. Yah farq isliye hota hai ki bazaar mein daam pal-pal badalta hai tatha bahut bade saude par kaafi share mil nahi paate; isliye yadi aap sau rupaye par kharidne ki soch rahe the par order poora hone tak daam sau tatha do rupaye ho jaye to yah do rupaye slippage hain. Sauda jaldi band karna, daam mein nuksan tatha software ka dosh isliye ye teeno alag matlab rakhte hain. Exam point: Slippage sochhe hue daam tatha milne wale daam ka antar hai - tez badalte bazaar mein yah badh jaata hai.

qe: What is a 'GDR' (Global Depository Receipt)?
o: Negotiable certificate issued by an international bank representing shares in a foreign corporation
e: GDR yani Global Depositary Receipt aisa kagaz hai jo antarrashtriya bank nikaalta hai tatha jiska aadhaar kisi videshi company ke share hote hain, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah raasta isliye istemal hota hai ki company apne desh se baahar doosre deshon ke niveshka se paisa juta sake bina wahan soochi par jaye; isliye bank company ke share apne paas rakhta hai tatha uske badle GDR bechta hai, jo videshi mudra mein bazaar par kharida-beche ja sakta hai. Sone ki jama ka record, sarkari karz ka record tatha kar ka prakar isliye ye teeno galat sabit hote hain. Exam point: GDR videshi company ke share par aadharit kagaz hai jo antarrashtriya bank nikaalta hai - yahi doosre desh se paisa jutane ka raasta hai.

qe: What is 'Systematic Risk' in investment portfolio theory?
o: Macroeconomic market-wide risk that cannot be eliminated through diversification
e: Systematic Risk aisa jokhim hai jo poore bazaar ko gher leta hai tatha alag-alag share chun kar kam nahi kiya ja sakta, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah jokhim isliye bacha nahi ja sakta ki mehngai, byaj ki dar tatha mandi ke badlav sabhi companyon par ek saath asar daalte hain; isliye niveshka yah jokhim kam karne ke liye index fund jaise poore bazaar wale upay chunta hai, par poori tarah hata nahi sakta. Vyaktigat nuksan, ek hi company ka jokhim tatha computer ke system ka dosh isliye ye teeno is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Systematic Risk poore bazaar ka jokhim hai - ise share chunte hue kam nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: What is 'Hedging' in investment management?
o: Taking an offsetting derivative position to mitigate unfavorable price movements
e: Hedging ka matlab hai aisi virodhi (opposite) sauda lagana jisse kharab daam se bacha ja sake, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah upay isliye liya jaata hai ki karobar mein daam ka badlav aseem nahi dekha ja sakta; isliye tel kharidne wali company aage ke daam ko baandhne ke liye derivate par ulat sauda leti hai, jisse girte daam par sauda ka nuksan par us daam se bach jaata hai, halaanki poora nuksan tatha laabh dono bandh ho jaate hain. Poora munafa kamana, keval sona kharidna tatha zyada byaj par paisa udhar dena isliye ye teeno is upay ke nahi hain. Exam point: Hedging mein ulat sauda le kar daam ke jokhim se bacha jaata hai - yah bima jaisa suraksha ka upay hai.

qe: What are 'Convertible Bonds'?
o: Bonds that can be converted into cash
Bonds that can be converted into a predetermined number of common equity shares
e: Convertible Bonds ve bond hote hain jinhe tay sankhya ke share mein badla ja sakta hai, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Yah bandhan isliye nikaale jaate hain ki company shuruat mein kam byaj dekar paisa jutana chahti hai tatha niveshka ko aage chal kar share ke dam badhne ka laabh milne ki umeed hoti hai; isliye jab share ka daam badhta hai to niveshka bond ko share mein badal deta hai, warna woh byaj leta rehta hai. Tohfe mein diye jaane wale bond, mishra jama ki parchi tatha nakad mein badalne wale kagaz isliye inhe is naam se nahi jaana jaata. Exam point: Convertible Bonds ko tay share mein badla ja sakta hai - isliye inhe byaj tatha share dono ka laabh milta hai.

qe: What is 'Averaging Down' in equity investing?
o: Purchasing more shares as market price declines to lower aggregate cost per share
e: Averaging ka matlab hai share ka daam girne par usi share ko aur kharidkar apni ausat laagat kam kar lena, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah upay isliye istemal hota hai ki niveshka pahle hi lagata hai daam giraya hua hai; isliye sau rupaye ka ek share tatha pachaas rupaye ka doosra share lekar ausat laagat pachhattar rupaye ho jaati hai, jisse daam thoda badhne par bhi nuksan nahi hota, par yah tarika tab khatarnaak hai jab company ya bazaar poora hi kamzor ho jaaye. Kul munafa jodna, ausat daam par bechna tatha kai khate kholna isliye ye teeno sawaal ke nahi hain. Exam point: Averaging mein girte daam par aur share kharidkar ausat laagat ghatayi jaati hai - yah sabhi bazaar mein hi samajhdaari hai.

qe: What is the 'Volatility Index' (VIX) commonly nicknamed?
qh: 'VIX' को अक्सर क्या कहा जाता है?
e: VIX ko aksar Fear Index ya Dar ka soochak kaha jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah soochak isliye dekha jaata hai ki ye batata hai niveshka agle mahine mein bazaar se kitna hilne ki umeed kar rahe hain; isliye jab VIX chadh jaata hai to samajh lena chahiye ki log darr rahe hain tatha unche jokhim wale saude chhod rahe hain, tatha jab VIX gir jaata hai to bazaar mein chain maana jaata hai. Vriddhi ka soochak, munafa ka meter tatha sone ka meter isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: VIX ko Fear Index kaha jaata hai - yah bazaar mein dar tatha ghabrahat ka aankda dikhata hai.

qe: What happens on the 'Ex-Dividend' date of a stock?
o: The cutoff date on or after which newly acquired shares do not carry rights to declared dividend
e: Ex-Dividend tithi wo aakhri seema hai jiske baad naye kharidne wale ko ghoshit labh nahi milta, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah tithi isliye tay ki jaati hai ki company ko pata rahe ki kise labh dena hai; isliye labh ghoshit hone ke baad jo naye share kharidte hain unke naam der se pahunchte hain tatha unhe labh nahi milta, tatha isi din share ka daam bhi labh ke barabar gir jaata hai. Koi nahi, labh ghoshna ka din tatha labh bhugtan ka din iske matlab nahi hain - ghoshna ke din company labh baantne ki khabar deti hai tatha bhugtan ke din paisa bheja jaata hai, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Exam point: Ex-dividend tithi ke baad kharide share par labh ka haq nahi milta - yah tithi bazaar band hone ke saath judi hoti hai.

qe: What is an 'ADR' (American Depositary Receipt)?
o: A type of US bank loan
A negotiable certificate issued by a US bank representing shares of a foreign company traded in the US
e: ADR yani American Depositary Receipt un papers ko kaha jaata hai jo America ke bank videshi company ke share ke badle bazaar mein bechte hain, isliye yahi sahi roop hai. Yah raasta isliye bana ki America ke aam niveshak bharat jaisi videshi companyon ke share seedhe nahi kharid sakte the; isliye videshi company America ke bank ke paas apne share rakhti hai tatha bank uske badle ADR bechta hai, jo America ke bazaar par dollar mein kharida-beche ja sakta hai. America ka bank karz, bharat ki mudra ka record tatha koi nahi isliye ye teeno is kagaz ki vyakhya nahi hain. Exam point: ADR American bank dwara nikaala gaya kagaz hai jo videshi company ke share darshaata hai - isse America mein videshi share kharide ja sakte hain.

qe: What does 'Mark-to-Market' (MTM) accounting entail in derivatives?
o: Daily accounting adjustment valuing outstanding contracts at prevailing settlement prices
e: Mark-to-Market ka matlab hai rozana ke ant mein bache saude ko us din ke aakhri daam par jodkar hisaab durust karna, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah tarika isliye zaroori hai ki derivate saude kai mahine chalte hain tatha us beech kisi ek paksh ke paas itna paisa na bache ki woh nuksan de sake; isliye rozana nuksan tatha munafa jodkar kam paisa wale paksh se suraksha bhandar maang liya jaata hai. Bikri par kar, munafa jodna tatha sampatti bikri karna isliye ye teeno galat sabit hote hain. Exam point: MTM mein bache saude ko rozana ke daam par jodkar hisaab durust kiya jaata hai - isse saude mein jokhim ka control hota hai.

qe: What is 'Sweat Equity' in corporate law?
o: Equity shares issued to employees or directors at a discount or for non-cash intellectual contribution
e: Sweat Equity ve share hote hain jo company apne karmikon ya adhikariyon ko chhot daam par yaa unke naye vichaar tatha mehanat ke badle deti hai, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Yah share isliye diye jaate hain ki naye kaam mein karmikon ko pakka paisa dene ki shamta kam hoti hai; isliye unhe company mein hissa dekar unka josh tatha bharosa juda rakha jaata hai tatha unhe nishchit samay tak bechna nahi hota. Garmi mein share kharidna, kisaanon ko diye share tatha koi nahi isliye ye teeno seedhe jude nahi hain. Exam point: Sweat Equity karmikon tatha adhikariyon ko unki mehanat ya vichaar ke badle diye share hote hain - yahi unhe company se jodta hai.

qe: What does a 'Credit Spread' indicate between debt securities?
o: Yield differential between a corporate bond and a risk-free benchmark treasury of equal maturity
e: Credit Spread company ke bond tatha usi avadhi ke bina-jokhim sarkari bond ki yield ka farq hota hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah farq isliye dekha jaata hai ki company sarkar se kam surakshit hoti hai, isliye niveshka zyada byaj maangta hai; isliye sarkari bond par 7 pratishat tatha company ke bond par 9 pratishat mil raha ho to do pratishat ka farq credit spread hai tatha yah farq company ke bigadne par badh jaata hai. Karz phailana, koi nahi tatha credit card ki seema isliye ye teenon me se koi sambandhit nahi. Exam point: Credit Spread company ke bond tatha bina-jokhim sarkari bond ki yield ka farq hai - yah company ke jokhim ka aankda hai.

qe: What is 'Price Discovery' in financial exchanges?
o: The dynamic process through which interactions of supply and demand set equilibrium market price
e: Price Discovery wo prakriya hai jismein kharidne tatha bechne wale ke aapasi saude se santulan ka daam khud ban jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Yah prakriya isliye zaroori hai ki kisi ko pehle se nahi pata hota ki share tatha anya cheez ki asli keemat kitni hai; isliye boli lagane wale, bazaar ke kharidne bechne wale tatha soochi ke niyam se milkar aisa daam banta hai jahan dono paksh tay ho jaate hain. Pradhikari dwara daam tay karna, koi nahi tatha purane daam khojna isliye inhe is naam se nahi jaana jaata. Exam point: Price Discovery mein maang tatha aapurti ke mel se bazaar ka santulan daam banta hai - yahi bazaar ka asli kaam hai.

qe: What is a 'Dark Pool' in equity trading?
qh: ट्रेडिंग में 'डार्क पूल' (Dark Pool) क्या है?
o: Private alternative trading venue where institutional orders execute without pre-trade public display
e: Dark Pool aisa niji manch hai jahan bade sansthaik niveshak ka sauda aam janta ko dikhaye bina poora hota hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah manch isliye bana ki ek hi baar mein lakhon share bechne par daam turant gir jaata hai tatha poore bazaar ko pata chal jaata hai ki badi bikri aane wali hai; isliye aisa niveshka chupchaap sauda karta hai, par soochi ke niyam ke hisaab se iska karobar bhi niyamit tatha saaf dikhane wale tarike se hota hai. Ghairkanooni kaala bazaar, koi nahi tatha bazaar band hone ke baad aam karobar isliye ye teenon me se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: Dark Pool niji manch hai jahan bade saude aam janta ko dikhaye bina poore hote hain - yah saade daam ko bigadne se bachata hai.

qe: What is 'Naked Short Selling'?
o: Selling shares short without first borrowing them or ensuring borrow availability
e: Naked Short Selling ka matlab hai share udhar liye bina ya udharki vyavastha pakki kiye bina bech dena, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah tarika isliye bahut jokhim bhara tatha kai deshon mein rok ke saath ya poori tarah band hai ki bechne wale ke paas share hi na ho to saude ke din woh unhe pahuncha hi nahi sakta, jisse bazaar mein jamav tatha bharosa kam hota hai; isliye bharat mein share bechne se pehle unka hona tatha demat mein pade hona zaroori hai. Raat mein share bechna, saadhaaran short selling tatha koi nahi isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: Naked Short Selling mein bina share udhar liye share bech diye jaate hain - isi liye ise bharat smait kai deshon mein rok lagti hai.

qe: What is a 'Wash Trade'?
o: An illegal manipulative transaction where the buyer and seller are identical, creating misleading trade volume
e: Wash Trade aisa galat tatha dhokhe wala sauda hai jismein kharidne tatha bechne wala ek hi vyakti hota hai, jisse nakli karobar ka chhapa banta hai, isliye yahi sahi pakad hai. Aisa karobar isliye khatarnaak hai ki isse aam niveshka ko lagta hai ki share mein badi hrik tatha maang hai, isliye woh upar daam par kharid leta hai; isi karan bharat mein aise saude par bhaari jurmana tatha kadhi karvai ka niyam hai. Laagat daam par bechna tatha khata saaf karna isliye ye teeno is vishay ke nahi hain. Exam point: Wash Trade mein ek hi vyakti dono taraf rahkar nakli karobar ka bharam khada karta hai - ise bazaar mein galat maana jaata hai aur gairkanoonii hai.

qe: What is a 'Rights Issue'?
o: Offering additional subscription shares to existing shareholders pro-rata at a discounted price
e: Rights Issue ka matlab hai company apne purane niveshkaa ko unke hisse ke anupaat mein chhot daam par naye share kharidne ka mauka dena, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Yah raasta isliye chuna jaata hai ki company ko naya paisa chahiye par woh bazaar mein naye share nikaalkar purane niveshkaa ka hissa kam nahi karna chahti; isliye purane niveshkaa ko pehle mauka milta hai tatha chhot daam ke laabh se woh apna hissa bachaate hain. Proxy voting ka haq, koi nahi wala vikalp tatha muft bonus share teeno is raaste se alag hain, isliye inhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: Rights Issue mein purane share-maali ko unke hisse ke anupaat mein chhot daam par naye share milte hain - yah company ke liye paisa jutane ka raasta hai.

qe: What is 'Front Running' in capital markets?
qh: स्टॉक ट्रेडिंग में 'फ्रंट रनिंग' (Front Running) क्या है?
o: Illegal practice of trading ahead of a known upcoming large non-public client order
e: Front Running aisi galat tatha gairkanoonii vidhi hai jismein koi apni jankari ke aadhar par bade grahak ke saude se pehle hi apna sauda kar leta hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah kaam isliye jokhim bhara hai ki bade grahak ke lakhon share kharidne ki khabar milte hi daam turant badhta hai; isliye jo pehle kharid leta hai woh grahak se kam daam par sauda karkar badhe daam par bechkar munafa kama leta hai, jisse aam grahak ka nuksan hota hai. Bazaar khulne par intraday karna, winning market share tatha koi nahi - ye sab is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Front Running aane wale bade saude se pehle khud sauda kar lena hai - isi liye ise galat tatha dandniy maana jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Churning' in brokerage practices?
o: Excessive, unauthorized buying and selling in a client's discretionary account to generate commissions
e: Churning ka matlab hai broker apne faayde ke liye grahak ke khatte mein bina izazat zyada karobar karwana, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Yah kaam isliye hota hai ki broker ko har saude par commission milta hai; isliye woh baar-baar kharid-beche karkar apni kamaai badha leta hai, chahe grahak ko isse koi laabh na ho, tabhi ise anuchit tatha niyam ke bahar maana jaata hai. Fund pooling, khata transfer tatha blue chip share kharidna isliye inhe is naam se nahi jaana jaata. Exam point: Churning broker dwara bina izazat zyada saude karwakar commission kamane ki galat vidhi hai.

qe: What is a 'Green Shoe Option' in an IPO prospectus?
qh: IPO में 'ग्रीन शू ऑप्शन' (Green Shoe Option) क्या है?
o: An over-allotment provision enabling underwriters to issue extra shares to stabilize post-listing prices
e: IPO mein Green Shoe Option aisi vyavastha hai jismein share nikaalne wale bank ko aavashyakta padne par kuchh zyada share bechkar bazaar ka daam sambhalne ka haq milta hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah haya isliye rakhi jaati hai ki naye share ke pehle dinon mein daam tez gir sakta hai; isliye bade bank kuchh share ko upar bechne ke liye baandhkar rakhte hain tatha zarurat padne par unhe dobara kharidkar daam sambhalte hain. Footwear kshetra, sirf nayi urja wale share tatha koi nahi - ye sab alag cheezein hain. Exam point: Green Shoe Option share ke upar-mujhe (extra issue) ki vyavastha hai - yahi listing ke baad daam ko sambhale rakhti hai.

qe: What is 'Price Rigging' in stock markets?
o: Unlawful collusion to artificially inflate, suppress, or peg the market price of a security
e: Price Rigging ka matlab hai galat tatha gairkanoonii milibhagat se share ka daam jaan-boojh kar upar ya nichhe dhauna, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah kaam isliye khatarnaak hai ki banaawaTa daam dekhkar aam niveshka kharid leta hai tatha baad mein daam gir jaata hai; isliye SEBI aise saude par kadi kadhi karvai tatha jurmana lagati hai. Uchit keemat ka aanklan, chhot daam tatha koi nahi - ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: Price Rigging share ka daam milibhagat se dhauna hai - isse aam niveshka ko dhokha hota hai.

qe: What is a 'Credit Default Swap' (CDS)?
o: A derivative contract transferring credit exposure of fixed-income products between counterparties
e: Credit Default Swap (CDS) aisa derivate sauda hai jismein ek paksh doosre ko karz ka jokhim badle mein fees dekar de deta hai, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah sauda isliye bana ki bond kharidne wale bank tatha sansthaon ko dar hota hai ki company diwaliya ho jaye; isliye woh kisi teesre paksh ko chhot bhugtan dekar yah suraksha kharidta hai ki company diwaliya hone par woh nuksan bharega, par yah asli karz ka kagaz nahi hota. Mudra ka karobar, koi nahi tatha surakshit karz isliye inmein se koi iski sahi vyakhya nahi deta. Exam point: Credit Default Swap mein karz ka jokhim fees lekar doosre paksh ko diya jaata hai - yahi bima jaisa suraksha kagaz hai.

qe: What is a 'Fallen Angel' in the fixed-income market?
qh: बॉन्ड मार्केट में 'फॉलन एंजेल' (Fallen Angel) क्या है?
o: A bond that was originally investment grade but downgraded to junk status
e: Fallen Angel aisa bond hota hai jo pehle acche darje ka tha par baad mein kam darje mein gir gaya, isliye yahi sahi roop hai. Yah sthiti isliye banti hai ki company ka munafa kam hone tatha karz badhne se rating agency uski shreni giradi hai; isliye aise bond ka bazaar daam gir jaata hai par niveshka ko zyada byaj milta hai, kyonki jokhim badh chuka hota hai. Nayi sarkari nikaasi, band ho chuka bank tatha koi nahi - ye sab is shabd ke matlab nahi hain. Exam point: Fallen Angel woh bond hai jo acche darje se giradkar kam darje mein aa gaya - iske baad ushe junk ke darje mein gina jaata hai.

qe: What is a 'Stop-Loss' order?
o: A conditional market order instructing broker execution when price drops to a designated stop price
e: Stop Loss order aisa order hai ki daam tay seema tak gire tatha bazaar mein khud bikri ho jaaye, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah sandesh isliye diya jaata hai ki niveshka girte daam mein poori poonji na khoye; isliye jis daam par ushe bahut nuksan shuru hone ka darr ho, wahan order pehle se laga diya jaata hai, par tez girti hui bazaar mein order thoda nichhe daam par poora ho sakta hai. Bina shart kharid ka order, karobar jamaane ka order tatha koi nahi - inhe is naam se nahi jaana jaata. Exam point: Stop Loss woh order hai jo daam tay seema chhune par bikri kar deta hai - yahi nuksan seemit rakhta hai.

qe: What is a 'Liquidity Trap' in Keynesian economics?
o: A condition where low or zero interest rates fail to induce investment or aggregate spending
e: Liquidity Trap waisi haalat hai jismein byaj ki dar bahut kam hone par bhi nivesh tatha kharch nahi badhte, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Yah haalat isliye aati hai ki log tatha bank bhavishya ko lekar dar ke mare nakad paisa hi thame rakhte hain; isliye Reserve Bank byaj ghatakar bhi maang nahi badha paati, kyonki paisa bankon se aage nahi nikalti. Koi nahi, nakad ghar ghere na hona tatha keval sone ka jodh isliye ye teeno is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Liquidity Trap mein byaj ghatane se bhi nivesh tatha kharch nahi badhte - yahi mudra niti ka nirashajanak mod hai.

qe: What is a 'Dead Cat Bounce' in technical analysis?
qh: 'डेड कैट बाउंस' (Dead Cat Bounce) क्या है?
o: A brief, deceptive upward recovery in prices during a sustained severe bear downtrend
e: Dead Cat Bounce ka matlab hai bahut girne ke baad daam mein thodi der ke liye aane wali dhokhe wali uthan, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah uthan isliye hoti hai ki kuchh log bahut sasta dekhte hi kharidne lagte hain; isliye daam thoda upar chadhkar dobara gir jaata hai, isliye ise bharosemand sudhaar nahi maan lena chahiye. Flash crash, tez badhne wala bazaar tatha koi nahi - ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: Dead Cat Bounce bahut girne ke baad aane wali thodi tatha dhokhe wali uthan hai - yah asli sudhaar nahi hoti.

qe: What is the 'Grey Market' in IPO terminology?
qh: IPO में 'ग्रे मार्केट' (Grey Market) क्या है?
o: An unofficial, over-the-counter market trading IPO applications and shares before official listing
e: Grey Market aisa ghair-aadhikarik bazaar hai jahan soochi par aane se pehle hi IPO application tatha share ka karobar hota hai, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Yah bazaar isliye banta hai ki niveshka ko lagta hai naya share aane par bade laabh milenge; isliye woh soochi par listing se pehle hi premium par kharid-beche karte hain, par ismein koi sarkari suraksha nahi hoti tatha yah SEBI ke niyamon ke bahar chalta hai. Koi nahi, rasmi share bazaar tatha sona-chandi ka bazaar isliye inhe is naam se nahi jaana jaata. Exam point: Grey Market IPO se pehle ka ghair-aadhikarik bazaar hai - yahan niveshka ko koi kanoonii suraksha nahi milti.

qe: What does 'Earnings Per Share' (EPS) represent?
o: Net corporate profit allocated to each outstanding common share
e: EPS yani Earnings Per Share batata hai ki company ke munafe ka kitna hissa ek share par aata hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah aankda isliye dekha jaata hai ki do companyon ke munafa ki tulna ek share ke hisaab se ki ja sake; isliye kul labh ko share ki sankhya se bhaag diya jaata hai tatha unch EPS ka matlab hai company apne niveshka ke liye zyada kama rahi hai. Koi nahi, kul bikri tatha labhansh ki dar isliye ye teenon me se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: EPS munafa ko ek share ke hisaab se naapta hai - isse pata chalta hai company per share kitna kama rahi hai.

qe: What is 'Window Dressing' in financial accounting?
o: Cosmetic, short-term accounting manipulations done to present favorable year-end reports
e: Window Dressing ka matlab hai saal ke ant mein hisaab acche dikhane ke liye thode samay ke liye chal kiye gaye jhootha-upay, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah kaam isliye hota hai ki company report mein apne munafa tatha karz ko acche roop mein dikhana chahti hai; isliye woh ant mein kuchh sampatti bech deti hai ya kharche taal deti hai, jisse niveshka asli sthiti se alag chitra dekhta hai. Naye share kharidna, koi nahi tatha office sajaana isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: Window Dressing saal ke ant mein hisaab sajaane ki thodi der ki chalaki hai - isse asli sthiti chhup jaati hai.

qe: What is the core principle of 'Gresham's Law'?
o: Bad money drives out good money from circulation
e: Gresham ka Niyam (Law) batata hai ki kharab mudra acche mudra ko bazaar se bhaga deti hai, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah niyam isliye chalta hai ki log acche dhaatu wale sikke apne paas bacha kar rakhte hain tatha kharab sikke kharch karte hain; isliye acche sikke thode-thode hi lenden mein bache rehte hain, thik isi tarah aaj bhi log acche note bachaa kar ghatiya note pehle chalate hain. Sasta kharid kar mehenga bechna, kam kar se zyada aay tatha koi nahi is niyam ke matlab nahi hain, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Exam point: Gresham ka Niyam kehta hai kharab mudra acche ko bhaga deti hai - yahi mudra ke chalan ka purana siddhant hai.

qe: What does a 'Call Option' grant its buyer?
o: The right, but not the obligation, to buy an underlying asset at a strike price within a set period
e: Call Option aisa haq hai jismein niveshka tay samay tatha tay daam par sampatti kharid sakta hai par ushe kharidna zaroori nahi, isliye yahi sahi roop hai. Yah haq isliye kharida jaata hai ki niveshka daam badhne ki umeed rakhta hai; isliye sampatti mehangi hone par woh tay daam par hi kharid leta hai tatha sasti hone par haq chhod deta hai, isliye ushe khokar fees se zyada nuksan nahi hota. Bina shart diya dena, koi nahi tatha dene ka haq is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Call Option kharidne ka haq hai, bandhan nahi - isliye niveshka daam badhne par laabh uthat a hai.

qe: What does a 'Put Option' grant its buyer?
o: The right, but not the obligation, to sell an underlying asset at a set strike price
e: Put Option aisa haq hai jismein niveshka tay daam par sampatti bech sakta hai par bechna zaroori nahi, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah haq isliye liya jaata hai ki niveshka girte daam se bachna chahta hai; isliye sampatti sasti ho jaane par woh tay daam par hi bech deta hai, jisse uska nuksan seemit rehta hai. Kharidne ka bandhan, pakki aay ki guarantee tatha koi nahi - ye sab alag cheezein hain. Exam point: Put Option bechne ka haq deta hai - yahi girte bazaar mein niveshka ko buraai se bachata hai.

qe: What is a 'Naked Option' position?
o: Writing/selling an option without owning the underlying asset or an offsetting hedge
e: Naked Option ka matlab hai bina sampatti rakhe ya suraksha sauda kiye option ko bech dena, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Yah kaam isliye bahut jokhim bhara hai ki option ka haq lene wala daam badalne par bechne wale se sampatti maang sakta hai; isliye bechne wale ke paas woh cheez na ho to ushe bazaar daam par kharidni padti hai, jisse poora nuksan usi par aata hai. Covered sauda, koi nahi tatha raat ka karobar isliye ye teeno is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Naked Option bina sampatti rakhe option bech dena hai - ismein nuksan ki koi tay seema nahi hoti.

qe: What are 'Blue Sky Laws' in United States jurisprudence?
qh: 'ब्लू स्काई लॉ' (Blue Sky Laws) क्या हैं?
o: State-level statutes regulating the offering and sale of securities to shield the public from fraud
e: Blue Sky Laws ve ameriki rajyon ke kanoon hain jo share nikaalne tatha bechne ke niyam banaate hain taaki aam janta dhokhe se bachi rahe, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah kanoon isliye bane ki bade saude mein aam niveshka ko company ki asli sthiti ka pata nahi ho jaata tha; isliye rajya star par saaf jankari dena tatha dhokhe par rok lagaana zaroori kiya gaya, tatha bharat mein SEBI ke niyam isi bhaavna se banaye gaye hain. Hawai seema ke niyam, koi nahi tatha mausam ke samjhauta isliye inmein se koi is shabd se nahi juda. Exam point: Blue Sky Laws ameriki rajya ke ve kanoon hain jo share ke saude mein dhokha rokte hain - yahi niveshka ki suraksha ka pehla upay tha.

qe: What does an 'In-the-Money' (ITM) option mean?
o: An option contract possessing intrinsic value based on current spot price relative to strike price
e: In-The-Money (ITM) option aisa sauda hota hai jismein abhi ke daam ke hisaab se asli laabh chhupa ho, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Ismein option ka aaj ka daam tatha tay daam ka farq asli keemat dikhata hai; isliye call option mein bazaar daam tay daam se upar ho to woh andar ki cheez hai tatha niveshka ushe chhodkar laabh uthata hai. Nayi muddat, koi nahi tatha ghaate wala sauda ye teeno alag cheezein hain. Exam point: ITM option mein asli laabh maujood hota hai - call mein bazaar daam tay daam se zyada hone par aisa hota hai.

qe: What does an 'Out-of-the-Money' (OTM) option mean?
o: An option contract possessing zero intrinsic value, composed entirely of extrinsic time value
e: Out-Of-The-Money (OTM) option aisa sauda hai jismein abhi ke daam par koi asli laabh nahi hota tatha poori keemat samay ki hoti hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah sthiti isliye dekhi jaati hai ki niveshka aage daam badhne tatha girne ki umeed par sasta option kharidta hai; isliye expant ke nazdeek aate-aate samay ki keemat ghat kar khatam ho jaati hai, isliye ismein jokhim zyada hota hai. Koi nahi, sauda poora hona tatha asli laabh hona inmein se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: OTM option mein asli laabh nahi hota - poori keemat samay ki hoti hai jo muddat khatam hone par khatam ho jaati hai.

qe: What is the 'Sharpe Ratio' used for in portfolio analysis?
o: A metric measuring excess investment return per unit of total risk (standard deviation)
e: Sharpe Ratio aankda batata hai ki niveshka ko ek jokhim ke badle mein kitna zyada munafa mila, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah aankda isliye istemal hota hai ki keval munafa dekhkar do funds ki tulna theek nahi hoti; isliye jis fund ne zyada jokhim uthakar munafa kamaya, uske aankde mein jokhim bhi jod diya jaata hai, tatha zyada anupaat wala fund behtar maana jaata hai. Labhansh ki dar, koi nahi tatha karz ka aankda isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: Sharpe Ratio jokhim ke badle mein mile zyada munafa ko naapta hai - isse funds ki asli kamaai ka pata chalta hai.

qe: What does 'Tracking Error' measure in index mutual funds and ETFs?
qh: म्यूचुअल फंड में 'ट्रैकिंग एरर' (Tracking Error) क्या है?
o: The standard deviation of excess return differences between an index fund and its benchmark
e: Tracking Error mutual fund ke munafa tatha uske aadhaar index ke munafa ke antar ka aankda hota hai, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah antar isliye dekha jaata hai ki index fund ko apna poora paisa theek usi share bhaar mein lagana hota hai; isliye kharcha, timing tatha nakad rakhne ke karan fund ka munafa index se thoda hatta rehta hai, tatha kam tracking error wala fund apne vaade par khara utarta hai. Bhugtan fail hona, koi nahi tatha turant ka bhugtan isliye ye teeno is vishay ke nahi hain. Exam point: Tracking Error fund tatha benchmark ke munafa ka antar naapta hai - kam error wala index fund behtar maana jaata hai.

qe: What is a 'White Knight' during a hostile corporate takeover?
o: A friendly acquirer that steps in to take over a target firm on better terms to block a hostile bidder
e: White Knight aisa dost tatha bhala kharidne wala hota hai jo dushman ke bhayankar takeover ko rokne ke liye behtar shartein par company ka adhigrahan kar leta hai, isliye yahi sahi roop hai. Yah vyavastha isliye banti hai ki company par uske dushman ne jabar-adhikaar ki koshish ki ho; isliye prabandhan aise dost ko apne share bechkar company ko dushman se bacha leta hai. Sarkari likvidetar, dushman raider tatha koi nahi - ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: White Knight dost kharidne wala hota hai - yahi company ko dushman takeover se bachata hai.

qe: What is the 'Poison Pill' defense in corporate governance?
o: A shareholder rights plan designed to dilute acquirer equity and make hostile takeovers prohibitive
e: Poison Pill aisi vyavastha hai jismein buy se pahle hi share-lene wale ka hissa badh jaaye tatha adhigrahan mehanga ho jaaye, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah plan isliye banaya jaata hai ki company ka prabandhan apni marji ke badle adhigrahan nahi chahta; isliye dushman kharidne wale ke naye share lene par purane niveshka ko chhot daam par zyada share milte hain tatha uski hisse kam ho jaati hai, jisse takeover mushkil ho jaata hai. Sampatti bikna tatha factory band karna - ye sab is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Poison Pill dushman adhigrahan ko mehanga tatha mushkil banane ki vyavastha hai - yahi prabandhan ki dhaal hoti hai.

qe: What is a 'Basis Point' (BPS) in finance?
e: Basis Point (BPS) ek pratishat ka sauvan hissa hota hai, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Yah chhota naap isliye istemal hota hai ki byaj ki dar tatha bond ke munafa mein chhote-chhote badlav ka bada asar hota hai; isliye paanch-bees basis point badhna ka matlab hai paanch ki chauthaai pratishat badhna, tatha Reserve Bank ki niti mein badlav aksar isi chhote naap mein bataya jaata hai. Koi nahi, ek pratishat badlav tatha das pratishat badlav isliye ye teeno is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: Ek basis point pratishat ka sauvaan hissa hota hai - isse byaj tatha munafa ke bare-bare badlav naape jaate hain.

qe: What is a company's 'Solvency'?
o: The long-term capability of a business to satisfy its non-current financial liabilities
e: Solvency kisi company ki lambi avadhi mein apne karz chukane ki shamta hoti hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah shamta isliye ahem hai ki roz ke bhugtan ke liye paisa hona (liquidity) tatha poora karz chukane ki shamta (solvency) do alag baatein hain; isliye company roz paisa chuka kar bhi apni sampatti se zyada karz hone par pehle diwalya ho sakti hai. Roz ki nakad sthit, sampatti bikri tatha koi nahi - inhe is baat se nahi joda jaata. Exam point: Solvency lambi avadhi mein karz chukane ki shamta hai - yahi company ke tike rehne ka asli aankda hai.

qe: Which organization regulates the 'Money Market' in India?
qh: भारत में 'मनी मार्केट' (मुद्रा बाजार) का नियामक कौन सा संगठन है?
e: Bharat mein money market yani mudra bazaar ka niyamak RBI hai, isliye yahi sahi naam hai. Yah baat isliye mahatvapurn hai ki ek saal se kam muddat wale kagaz jaise treasury bill, call money, commercial paper tatha CD bankon tatha bade sansthaon ke beech lagte hain; isliye inki nigrani Reserve Bank karti hai, jabki share tatha lambi avadhi ke kagaz ki nigrani SEBI ke paas hai. Vitta Mantralaya niti banata hai, NABARD gaon ke bankon ko paisa deta hai tatha SEBI keval share bazaar ka niyamak hai, isliye inhe is kaam ke sahi naam nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: mudra bazaar ka niyamak RBI hai - ek saal se kam wale kagaz inke daayre mein aate hain.

qe: What is the minimum denomination for issuing a 'Certificate of Deposit' (CD) in India?
qh: 'सर्टिफिकेट ऑफ डिपॉजिट' (CD) कितनी न्यूनतम राशि के लिए जारी किया जा सकता है?
e: Certificate of Deposit (CD) ke liye nyunatam rakam ek lakh rupaye hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah niyam isliye banaya gaya ki CD bank tabhi nikaalta hai jab ushe bade sansthaon se tatha khoj-khabar rakhne wale niveshkaa se paisa jutana ho; isliye chhot rakam wale grahak ke liye sadharan jama khate hain tatha CD ko bade pamana ke paise ka saadhan maana jaata hai, jiski muddat aam taur par saat se 365 din tak hoti hai. Paanch lakh, pachaas hazaar tatha pachchis hazaar is seema se alag aakde hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CD ki nyunatam rakam ek lakh rupaye hai - yahi bade paise ka chhota samay wala bank kagaz hai.

qe: Which money market paper is an unsecured promissory note issued by highly rated corporates?
qh: बड़े निगमों द्वारा जारी किए जाने वाले किस मनी मार्केट उपकरण को 'प्रॉमिसरी नोट' भी कहा जाता है?
e: Commercial Paper ko promissory note bhi kaha jaata hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai; yah bade tatha acche darje wale nigamon ki khevra hai jise woh apni rozmarra ki zarurat ke liye bina suraksha nikaalte hain. Yah kagaz isliye lokpriya hai ki ismein bankon se karz lene se sasta paisa milta hai tatha iski muddat keval pandrah din se ek saal tak hoti hai, par ismein byaj tay hota hai tatha niveshka ke liye jokhim kam hota hai. Call money, CD tatha treasury bill teeno alag kagaz hain - call money ek din ka bankon ka karz hai tatha Sarkar treasury bill nikaalti hai, isliye ye teeno sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Commercial Paper ko promissory note kaha jaata hai - yahi nigamon ki chhoti avadhi ki bina suraksha khevra hai.

qe: What is the maturity duration of 'Call Money' in interbank transactions?
qh: 'कॉल मनी' की अधिकतम अवधि क्या है?
e: Call Money ki adhiktam avadhi ek din yani raat bhar ki hoti hai, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah avadhi isliye itni chhoti hai ki bankon ko roz ke bhugtan tatha niyam ke hisaab se nakad rakhna hota hai; isliye bank ek doosre se keval ek din ke liye udhar lete hain tatha agli subah paisa wapas kar dete hain, isliye is par lagne wali dar mudra bazaar ki sabse tez badalne wali dar maani jaati hai. Chaudah din, saat din tatha tees din wale vikalp is avadhi se alag hain, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Exam point: Call Money ek din ke liye udhar liya jaane wala paisa hota hai - iski dar bankon ki nakad sthit ka aankda hai.

qe: In India, Treasury Bills are issued exclusively by which authority?
qh: भारत में, ट्रेजरी बिल केवल __________ द्वारा जारी किए जाते हैं?
e: Bharat mein treasury bill keval kendriya sarkar nikaalti hai, isliye doosra vikalp theek baithta hai. Yah kagaz isliye nikaala jaata hai ki sarkar ko chhote samay ke liye paisa chahiye hota hai tatha ushe mahange karz se bachna hai; isliye Reserve Bank sarkar ke liye niveshkaa se paisa le kar bharosa deta hai ki ek saal ke andar poora paisa wapas milega. Niji companyon, sarkari bankon tatha rajya sarkaron ke paas yah adhikar nahi hota, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: treasury bill keval kendriya sarkar nikaalti hai - yahi ek saal se kam ka sabse surakshit kagaz hai.

qe: What is the minimum maturity period for 'Commercial Paper' in India?
qh: भारत में 'कमर्शियल पेपर' के लिए न्यूनतम परिपक्वता अवधि क्या है?
e: Bharat mein Commercial Paper ki nyunatam avadhi saat din hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah seema isliye tay ki gayi ki CP bade tatha acche darje wale nigamon ki bahut chhoti zarurat ke liye hai; isliye yah saat din se ek saal tak ki avadhi ke liye nikaala ja sakta hai tatha ise bina suraksha nikaala jaata hai, isliye niveshka ko jokhim bhi uthana padta hai. Pandrah din, ek din tatha teen mahine wale vikalp is niyam ke sahi aakde nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: Commercial Paper ki nyunatam avadhi saat din hai - yahi nigamon ka chhota avadhi wala kagaz hai.

qe: What is 'Notice Money' in the interbank market?
qh: बैंकिंग क्षेत्र में 'नोटिस मनी' क्या है?
o: Interbank funds borrowed or lent for 2 to 14 days
e: Notice Money bankon ke aapasi udhar ka wo roop hai jismein paisa do se chaudah din ke liye liya-diya jaata hai, isliye teesri vyakhya sahi hai. Yah naam isliye pada ki bankon ko itne chhote samay mein paisa turant chahiye hota hai tatha woh pehle hi soochna de dete hain; isliye yah call money se lambi tatha teen mahine se chhoti avadhi ka bazaar hai tatha isi dar se unki rozmarra ki nakad sthit ka pata chalta hai. Ek mahine ka karz, ek din ka karz tatha kisaanon ka karz is naam ke matlab nahi hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp theek nahi hain. Exam point: Notice Money do se chaudah din ke liye bankon ke aapasi udhar ko kaha jaata hai - yah call money se aage ka star hai.

qe: What is the minimum face value denomination of a standard Indian 'Treasury Bill'?
qh: ट्रेजरी बिल का अंकित मूल्य आमतौर पर किस राशि में जारी किया जाता है?
e: Treasury bill par chhapne wali rakam aam taur par pachchis hazaar rupaye ho sakti hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah seema isliye rakhi gayi ki T-bills bade niveshkaa tatha sansthaon ke liye hote hain tatha unhe chhote-chhote tukdon mein todna mehanga padta hai; isliye pachchis hazaar rupaye tatha uske gunj mein hi yah kagaz milta hai, jisse sarkar ko kam kharche mein bada karz mil jaata hai. Das hazaar, ek lakh tatha paanch hazaar wale aakde is niyam se alag hain, isliye wo teenon me se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: treasury bill aam taur par pachchis hazaar rupaye tatha uske gunj mein nikaale jaate hain - yahi bade paise ka surakshit sarkari kagaz hai.

qe: Commercial Papers were officially introduced in the Indian financial system in which year?
qh: भारत में पहली बार कमर्शियल पेपर किस वर्ष शुरू किए गए थे?
e: Bharat mein Commercial Paper ki shuruat 1990 mein hui thi, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah badlav isliye aaya ki tab desh mein aise kagaz ki zarurat mehsoos hui jo bankon ke karz se sasta tatha tez ho; isliye aise nigamon ke liye raasta khola gaya jo acche darje wale hain tatha bina suraksha paisa juta sakte hain, jisse chhoti avadhi ka paisa bazaar phalne-phoolne laga. Unnis sau bayanave, do hazaar tatha unnis sau assi is tithi se alag saal hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Commercial Paper bharat mein 1990 se shuru hua - yahi mudra bazaar ka ahem sudhaar tha.

qe: Standard Indian sovereign Treasury Bills are issued with which of the following maturity tenors?
qh: भारत में 'ट्रेजरी बिल' की मानक परिपक्वता अवधियां क्या हैं?
e: Treasury bill ki manak avadhiyan 91, 182 tatha 364 din ki hoti hain, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah avadhiyan isliye chuni gayi ki sarkar ko teen mahine, chhah mahine tatha ek saal ke hisaab se paisa chahiye hota hai; isliye sarkari sasta karz lene wale tatha bank short term ke faisle inke aadhar par karte hain tatha niveshka jitni lambi avadhi chune, utna hi zyada munafa paata hai. Ek-do-paanch saal, chaudah din tatha tees-saath-nabbe din wale vikalp T-bill ki avadhi nahi hain - saal se lambi avadhi sarkari bond ki hoti hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: treasury bill 91, 182 tatha 364 din ki avadhi ke liye nikaale jaate hain - ek saal se lamba karz sarkari bond hota hai.

qe: Why are sovereign Treasury Bills classified as 'Zero Coupon Bonds'?
qh: ट्रेजरी बिल को 'जीरो कूपन बॉन्ड' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: They are issued at a discount and redeemed at full face value without periodic interest payments
They are unbacked by sovereign credit
e: Treasury bill ko zero coupon bond kaha jaata hai kyonki yah chhot daam par milta hai tatha poore mulya par chukaya jaata hai, bich mein koi byaj nahi milta, isliye yahi sahi roop hai. Yah tarika isliye chuna jaata hai ki sarkar ko har mahine byaj dene ka jhanjhat nahi karna padta; isliye niveshka chhot daam dekar poora mulya paata hai tatha dono ke farq ko uski kamaai maana jaata hai, isliye ise bina coupon wala bond kehte hain. Anant muddat, ghayalvar byaj dar tatha sarkari suraksha ke bina hona iske matlab nahi hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: treasury bill bina byaj wala kagaz hai jo chhot daam par milta hai - yahi ise zero coupon bond kehlata hai.

qe: What does 'MIBOR' stand for in interbank pricing?
e: MIBOR ka poora naam Mumbai Interbank Offered Rate hai, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah dar isliye ahem hai ki yah batata hai bank ek doosre se paisa kitni dar par lete hain; isliye yah badti-girti mudra bazaar ki halat dikhati hai tatha kai karz tatha derivate saude isi dar se jude hote hain, thik usi tarah jaise videsh mein LIBOR chalta tha. Baaki teen naam sunne mein milte-julte hain par asli poore naam nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: MIBOR bankon ke aapasi udhar ki dar ka naap hai - isi se lambi avadhi ke karz tatha derivate saude jude hote hain.

qe: What is the maximum statutory maturity duration for all money market instruments?
qh: मुद्रा बाजार उन वित्तीय संपत्तियों का लेन-देन करता है जिनकी परिपक्वता अवधि होती है?
e: Mudra bazaar un kagaz ka karobar karta hai jinki avadhi ek saal tatha usse kam hoti hai, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Yah seema isliye bandhi hai ki ek saal ke andar wapas milne wale paise ko bank apni rozmarra ki zarurat ke liye surakshit maante hain; isliye T-bill, call money, CP tatha CD jaise kagaz isi bazaar mein chalta hain, jabki lambi avadhi ke sarkari bond tatha share capital bazaar ke vishay hain. Bina avadhi seema, paanch saal se zyada tatha ek se paanch saal wale vikalp is niyam se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: mudra bazaar mein ek saal tak ki avadhi ke kagaz chalta hain - isse lambi avadhi capital bazaar ka kaam hai.

qe: What is the primary operational effect when the RBI buys sovereign securities via Open Market Operations (OMOs)?
qh: जब RBI 'ओपन मार्केट' में प्रतिभूतियां खरीदता है तो क्या होता है?
e: Jab RBI khule bazaar mein pratibhutiyan kharidta hai to bankon ke paas paisa badh jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah kaam isliye kiya jaata hai ki bazaar mein paisa kam pad jaye tatha byaj ki dar chadhi jaane se karobar tham na jaye; isliye Reserve Bank purane bond tatha anya kagaz kharidkar bankon ke hathon mein nakad daalti hai, jisse wah paisa aage karz de paate hain tatha mehngai purane tay seema ke aas-paas rehti hai. SLR badhna, bankon ka paisa ghatna tatha videshi mudra bhandar girna iske natije nahi hain - SLR badhana paisa kheenchne ka upay hai, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: khule bazaar mein kharid se bankon ke paas paisa badhta hai - yahi paisa badhane ka sabse aam upay hai.

qe: What was the purpose of introducing the 'Market Stabilization Scheme' (MSS) in India?
o: Absorbing durable surplus rupee liquidity arising from heavy foreign exchange inflows
e: Market Stabilisation Scheme aisa bandobast hai jismein sarkar tatha Reserve Bank milkar bazaar se bhari huii rupaye ki adhikta kheench lete hain, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai.
