Yah yojana isliye banai gayi ki jab bahut zyada videshi paisa aata hai to rupaye ki aapurti bhadh jaati hai tatha mehngai badhti hai; isliye sarkari kagaz nikaalkar wah paisa baandh liya jaata hai, tatha aise kagaz ka paisa alag khate mein rakha jaata hai. Share ka control, niryat badhana tatha koi nahi is yojana ke matlab nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: MSS videshi paise se aayi bhari rupee ko kheenchne ki vyavastha hai - yahi mehngai rokne ka upay hai.

qe: What is the current base year for calculating the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) in India?
qh: भारत में WPI सूचकांक के लिए 'आधार वर्ष' क्या है?
e: Bharat mein WPI soochak ka aadhar varsh 2011-12 hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah aadhar varsh isliye chuna jaata hai ki thok bazaar ke daam ke badlav ki tulna ek hi sanyukt saal se ki ja sake; isliye WPI ki tulanatmak soochi banane ke liye 2011-12 ko aadhar maana jaata hai tatha aadhar badalne par poore purane aankdon ki gannana phir se hoti hai. Do hazaar chaar-paanch, do hazaar bees-ikkees tatha do hazaar pandrah-solah aadhar varsh nahi hain - aaj CPI ka aadhar varsh 2012 hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: WPI ka aadhar varsh 2011-12 hai - aadhar varsh badalne par soochi ke saare aankde phir se jode jaate hain.

qe: Which interest rate is designated as the primary 'Policy Rate' by the Reserve Bank of India?
qh: भारत में किस दर को 'नीतिगत दर' (Policy Rate) कहा जाता है?
e: Bharat mein Repo Rate ko nitigat dar (Policy Rate) kaha jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah dar isliye sabse ahem hai ki isi par bank Reserve Bank se chhote samay ke liye paisa lete hain; isliye yah badhte hi poore bazaar mein karz mehanga ho jaata hai tatha mehngai thamti hai, tatha ghatte hi karz sasta hokar nivesh tatha kharid badhti hai. SLR, Bank Rate tatha CRR bhi ahem aakde hain par nitigat dar ka rukh in se nahi dikhaya jaata, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: Repo Rate hi nitigat dar hai - isi par RBI se bank chhote samay ke liye paisa lete hain.

qe: How many total voting members constitute India's 'Monetary Policy Committee' (MPC)?
qh: 'मौद्रिक नीति समिति' (MPC) में कितने सदस्य होते हैं?
e: Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) mein chhah sadasya hote hain, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah sankhya isliye tay ki gayi ki faisle mein sarkar tatha Reserve Bank dono ka barabar hissa rahe; isliye teen sadasya RBI se tatha teen sarkar ke chune hue hote hain, tatha gavarnar ke paas nirnayak mat hota hai, jisse mehngai ka lakshya poora karne ke liye tarakkar faisla hota hai. Chaar, das tatha teen wale vikalp is sankhya se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: MPC mein chhah sadasya hote hain - yahi mehngai tatha byaj ki dar ka faisla karti hai.

qe: What is the 'Marginal Standing Facility' (MSF) rate in Indian monetary operations?
o: A penal overnight lending window where banks can borrow from RBI by dipping into SLR reserves
e: Marginal Standing Facility aisa dandatmak raasta hai jismein bank Reserve Bank se raat bhar ke liye paisa lete hain tatha badle mein unke paas sarkari kagaz kam pad jaate hain, isliye teesri vyakhya sahi hai. Yah suvidha isliye di gayi ki kisi bank ke paas nakad ki kami ho jaye par woh bazaar se nahi juta paaye; isliye Reserve Bank SLR ke kagaz ke badle mehangi dar par paisa deti hai, isliye bank ise zyada din tak istemal nahi karna chahte. Koi nahi, kheti ke karz ki suvidha tatha share bazaar ki seema is raaste ke matlab nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: MSF dandatmak raat bhar ki suvidha hai jismein SLR ke kagaz se paisa milta hai - yahi bazaar band hone tatha khulne ke beech ka sahara hai.

qe: What is the maximum statutory transaction limit for an 'Immediate Payment Service' (IMPS) transfer?
qh: 'IMPS' लेनदेन की अधिकतम सीमा क्या है?
e: IMPS ke ek saude ki adhiktam seema paanch lakh rupaye hai, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah suvidha isliye aisi bani ki yah chaubees ghante tatha saaton din chalu rehti hai; isliye chhot tatha madhyam paise ke turant bhejne ke liye yah sadhan prasiddh hua tatha ismein jitna bada sauda ho, utno hi zyada suraksha jaanch ki zarurat padti hai. Do lakh, koi seema nahi tatha ek lakh wale aakde is ke barabar nahi hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: IMPS mein ek saude ki seema paanch lakh rupaye hai - yah suvidha har samay chalti rehti hai.

qe: What does 'Shadow Banking' refer to in financial economics?
o: Credit intermediation conducted by non-bank financial intermediaries (NBFCs) outside regular banking regulations
e: Shadow Banking yani chhaya bank vyavastha aisi karz dene ki vidhi hai jo niveshka se paisa lekar karz deti hai par us par bankon wale sakht niyam nahi lagte, isliye chauthe vikalp wali vyakhya sahi hai; NBFC iska bada udaharan hain. Yah vidhi isliye badhi ki bankon ke niyam kade hone se kai log tatha chhote karobar wahan se karz nahi le paate; isliye chhaya bank badi pamana par karz dekar poore bazaar mein jokhim badha deti hain, tatha sankat ke samay uski kagazon ki keemat khatam ho jaati hai. Koi nahi, bina anumati ka khufiya karz tatha raat ka nakad bhugtan isliye ye sab is shabd se alag hain. Exam point: chhaya bank vyavastha vah karz dene ki vidhi hai jo bankon ke sakht niyamon se bahar chalti hai - yahi badi manda mein bada jokhim banti hai.

qe: What is the consumer inflation target mandated to the RBI under the flexible inflation targeting framework?
qh: लचीले मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्यीकरण ढांचे के तहत RBI के लिए 'मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य' क्या है?
o: 4% with a tolerance band of +/- 2% (2% to 6%)
e: Lachile mudrasphiti lakshyikaran ke tahat Reserve Bank ka lakshya 4 pratishat hai tatha isme 2 pratishat ka ghat-badh (yani 2 se 6 pratishat) chhoot hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah vyavastha isliye banai gayi ki mehngai ke aakde har mahine badalte hain tatha ek chhote aakde par kadi pakad se karobar ruk sakta hai; isliye lakshya 4 pratishat rakha gaya, aur yah bandh hara sarkar tatha RBI milkar lagbhag paanch saal ke liye tay karte hain. Do pratishat, aath pratishat tatha chhah pratishat wale vikalp is bandh se alag hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: mehngai ka lakshya 4 pratishat hai tatha 2 se 6 pratishat ki chhoot chalti hai - yahi lachile lakshyikaran ka core hai.

qe: Which economic demographic group suffers the greatest loss during unexpected inflation?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'अप्रत्याशित मुद्रास्फीति' से सबसे अधिक नुकसान होता है?
e: Achaanak aayi mehngai se sabse zyada nuksan paisa dene wale tatha pakki aay wale logon ka hota hai, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Yah nuksan isliye hota hai ki karz ki wapsi pehle tay ho chuki hoti hai; isliye jab daam badhte hain to jo paisa udhar diya tha uski asli keemat kam ho jaati hai, tatha pension tatha fixed deposit par milne wali kamai bhi ghat jaati hai. Karz lene wale, share wale maalik tatha vyapari is sthiti mein laabh uthate hain kyonki unka karz sasta ho jaata hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: achaanak aayi mehngai karz dene wale tatha pakki aay wale ko nuksan deti hai - yahi mehngai ka sabse bada prakop hai.

qe: What is the 'Base Effect' in calculating year-on-year inflation?
qh: मुद्रास्फीति की गणना में 'बेस इफेक्ट' (Base Effect) क्या है?
o: Impact of central bank discount changes
Distortion in current inflation rates caused by unusually high or low price indices in the corresponding prior year period
e: Base Effect ka matlab hai ki agle saal ki mehngai ke aakde par pichhle saal ke unche ya nichhe daam ka asar dikhta hai, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah asar isliye khada hota hai ki soochi ki tulna pichhle saal ke aakade se hoti hai; isliye yadi pichhle saal daam bahut badhe the tatha is saal wahi daam tik gaye, to mehngai ki dar kam dikhti hai, chahe daam kam nahi huye - isliye soochi ke aakde samajhne ke liye base effect ka dhyan rakhna zaroori hai. Kar ki sanrachna, koi nahi tatha bank ki byaj dar ke badlav isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: Base Effect pichhle saal ke daam ke asar se mehngai ki dar ka tirchha dikhna hai - iske bina aakde jhoothe lagte hain.

qe: What is 'Shrinkflation'?
o: Downsizing product quantity or volume while keeping the retail shelf price unchanged
A decline in nominal price tags
e: Shrinkflation ka matlab hai company daam wahi rakhkar pack mein maal ki matra kam kar deti hai, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Aisa chalan isliye chalta hai ki grahak daam ke aakde par zyada dhyan deta hai tatha maal ki matra par kam; isliye 100 rupaye ka packet pehle 200 gram ka tha tatha aaj 180 gram ka ho jaata hai, jisse asal mein cheez mehangi ho jaati hai par daam wahi dikhta hai. Koi nahi, daam ke tag ka girna tatha GDP ki badhotar ka girna isliye ye sab is vishay ke nahi hain. Exam point: Shrinkflation mein matra kam hoti hai daam wahi rehta hai - isliye aam grahak ko dhokha hota hai.

qe: What is 'Reflation' in monetary policy?
o: Deliberate fiscal or monetary stimulus deployed to lift price levels and output out of deflationary slumps
e: Reflation ka matlab hai jaan-boojh kar kharch tatha mudra badhakar daam tatha utpadan ko bahut nichhe se upar laana, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah raasta isliye apnaya jaata hai ki lambi mandi tatha apasphiti ke baad karobar tham jaata hai; isliye sarkar naye kaam tatha kar kam karke tatha Reserve Bank byaj ghatakar paisa bazaar mein daalti hai, jisse nivesh tatha rozgar badhe, par yah bahut tez kiya jaye to mehngai bhi badh sakti hai. Daam par zabardasti seema tatha tez badhti mehngai is shabd se nahi jude, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: Reflation jaan-boojh kar li gayi hui tez badhotar hai jo apasphiti se bahar nikaalti hai - yahi sudhaar ka anushansit roop hai.

qe: What does an 'Agglomeration Economy' represent?
o: Productivity and cost advantages that businesses gain by clustering geographically near each other
e: Agglomeration Economy ka matlab hai ek hi jagah par kai karobar ikatthe hone se laagat ghatna tatha kamai badhna, isliye yahi sahi roop hai. Yah laabh isliye milta hai ki ek jagah par saanjhe sadak, bijli, kaarigar tatha grahak ikatthe ho jaate hain; isliye ek hi kshetra mein kai factoryon ko sasta tatha aasan saaman milta hai, isliye yahi karan hai ki share bazaar, software tatha kapde ke udyog alag-alag sheheron mein jamte hain. Antitrust badlav, koi nahi tatha kheti mein atm-nirbharta isliye ye sab galat sabit hote hain. Exam point: Agglomeration Economy ikatthe hone se milne wali laabt hai - yahi sheheron mein udyog jamne ka karan hai.

qe: What is the 'Cheque Truncation System' (CTS) deployed in Indian clearing operations?
o: Electronic image-based clearing system eliminating the physical transit of paper cheques
e: Cheque Truncation System aisi vyavastha hai jismein cheque ki tasveer bheji jaati hai tatha kagaz ka safar band ho jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi paribhasha hai. Yah sudhaar isliye laaya gaya ki pehle cheque ek sheher se doosre sheher jaane mein kai din lagte the tatha raste mein khone ka jokhim rehta tha; isliye ab scan karke electronic roop mein hi cheque ka bhugtan ho jaata hai, jisse samay bachta hai tatha dhokha bhi kam hota hai. Sabhi cheque band karna, bhugtan rokna tatha koi nahi is vyavastha ke matlab nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: CTS cheque ki tasveer dwara bhugtan ki vyavastha hai - yahi kagaz ke cheques ka safar khatam karti hai.

qe: What is the 'Real Interest Rate'?
qh: 'वास्तविक ब्याज दर' (Real Interest Rate) क्या है?
o: Nominal interest rate minus the rate of inflation
e: Real Interest Rate ka matlab hai aisi wapasi ki dar jo mehngai ghatane ke baad bachti hai, isliye yahi sahi bayaan hai. Iska hisaab isliye lagaya jaata hai ki daam badhne se karz ki asli kamai kam ho jaati hai; isliye yadi bank aath pratishat byaj de raha hai tatha mehngai paanch pratishat hai, to asli kamai keval teen pratishat ke barabar hai, isliye bank wala aankda mehngai se zyada hona chahiye. Repo ki dar, koi nahi tatha sone par byaj inmein is shabd ki baat nahi hai, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: asli byaj ki dar mehngai ghatane ke baad bachne wali kamai hai - yahi bachatkar tatha karz dene wale ka asli laabh hai.

qe: What is the core distinction between 'Balance of Trade' (BoT) and 'Balance of Payments' (BoP)?
o: BoT includes capital transfers; BoP includes imports only
BoT accounts solely for merchandise (visible) goods exports and imports
e: Vyapar Santulan (BoT) keval dikhne wale maal ke aayatan tatha niryatan ka hisaab rakhta hai, isliye yahi sahi tay hua hai. Yah farq isliye ahem hai ki chal tatha yatra jaisi adrishya cheezein ismein nahi jodti; isliye santulan mein ghatte ka matlab hai desh ne maal ki tulna mein zyada paisa bahar bheja, par yah poore bhugtan santulan ka aadha hi chitra hota hai kyonki usmein nivesh tatha karz bhi jodte hain. Keval bhandaar, capital transfer tatha koi antar nahi wale vikalp isliye inmein is shabd ki baat nahi hai. Exam point: Vyapar Santulan keval dikhne wale maal ka hisaab hai - ismein seva tatha nivesh nahi jodte, isliye yah poora chitra nahi deta.

qe: What does 'Engel’s Law' state regarding consumer spending patterns?
o: As household income rises, the proportion of income spent on food declines
Tax revenues peak at 50% flat rates
e: Engel ka Niyam kehta hai ki ghar ki kamai badhne par khane-peene par lagne wale aay ka hissa ghat jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi jawab hai. Yah niyam isliye chalta hai ki bhookh ki seema hoti hai tatha kamai badhne par log saaf-safai, padhai tatha suvidhaon par zyada kharch karte hain; isliye gareeb ghar mein khane ka hissa sabse bada hota hai tatha ameer ghar mein sabse chhota, isliye yah niyam aaj bhi kamai tatha kharch samajhne mein kaam aata hai. Daam tatha aapurti ka seedha niyam, jansankhya ka ghan roop tatha kar ki chhati seema is niyam ke matlab nahi hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: Engel ka Niyam batata hai ki kamai badhne par khane par lagne wali kamai ka hissa ghatta hai - yahi gareebi tatha kharch ka aankda hai.

qe: What is 'Invisible Trade' in international economics?
o: Cross-border trade in intangible services (consulting, software, shipping, tourism)
e: Adrishya vyapar ka matlab hai seema ke paar chhoti-chhoti sevaon ka lena-dena jaise software, salah, jahaajraani tatha paryatan, isliye yahi sahi arth hai. Yah vyapar isliye badha ki aaj kaam kagaz ke bina tatha internet ke zariye seema paar ho jaata hai; isliye ismein maal dikhta nahi, isliye ise adrishya kaha jaata hai, tatha yahi bharat ki kamai aane ka bada sadhan hai. Bina soochit kheti ka bartar, koi nahi tatha taskari ki tashkili isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: adrishya vyapar sewaon ka seema-paar lena-dena hai - ismein software tatha shipping ki kamai sabse badi hai.

qe: What is a 'Giffen Good' in consumer microeconomics?
o: A low-income non-luxury good whose consumption increases as its price increases, defying the law of demand
e: Giffen Good aisa sasta saman hai jiska daam badhne par bhi logon ki kharid badh jaati hai, isliye yahi sahi matlab hai. Yah vyavhaar maang ke niyam ke ulat dikhta hai tatha tab hota hai jab saman gareeb ghar ke liye bahut zaroori ho tatha uske badle koi doosra sasta rasta na ho; isliye daam badhne par woh log baaki achhi cheezein chhodkar usi sasti cheez par apna paisa lagate hain, jaise gaon mein mota anaj tatha kuchh sasti rozmarra ki cheezein dikhati hain. Koi nahi, bina daam ki suvidha tatha bade darje ki cheez ye teeno is shabd se alag hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: Giffen Good mein daam badhne par kharid badhti hai - yahi maang ke niyam ka apsaman hai.

qe: What is 'Opportunity Cost'?
o: The value of the next best alternative forgone when a choice is made
e: Avsar Laagat (Opportunity Cost) ka matlab hai jo cheez chunne ke liye jo sabse badhiya mauka chhod diya jaata hai, uski keemat, isliye yahi theek vyakhya hai. Yah dhaarna isliye zaroori hai ki har chunav mein kuchh aur paana chhut jaata hai; isliye chhatra agar do saal padhai par lagata hai to un do saalon mein kamayi ka mauka chhut jaata hai, isliye asli laagat dekhne wale hisaab wale kharch tatha chhute mauke dono jodte hain. Sadharan laagat, koi nahi tatha kul likhit kharch isliye inmein se koi is dhaarna ki sahi vyakhya nahi deta. Exam point: Avsar Laagat us sabse behtar vikalp ki keemat hai jo chhut jaata hai - isliye nirnay lete samay ise jodna zaroori hai.

qe: What defines 'Pareto Efficiency' in welfare economics?
o: An economic state where no individual can be made better off without making at least one individual worse off
e: A Pareto optimal allocation allows no further trade reallocations that help someone without causing harm to another. / ऐसी स्थिति जहां किसी एक व्यक्ति की स्थिति को बेहतर बनाने के लिए किसी अन्य की स्थिति को खराब करना अपरिहार्य हो।

qe: What is a 'Transfer Payment' in macroeconomic accounting?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'हस्तांतरण भुगतान' (Transfer Payment) क्या है?
o: Unilateral redistribution of income by the government without corresponding production of goods or services
e: Transfer payments (like pensions, welfare grants, and scholarships) do not represent output and are excluded from GDP. / सरकार द्वारा बिना किसी सेवा या उत्पादन के बदले नागरिकों को दिया जाने वाला एकतरफा भुगतान।

qe: What empirical correlation is established by 'Okun’s Law'?
o: Relationship between unemployment rate changes and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth
e: Okun's law predicts that for every percentage point unemployment rises above natural levels, GDP dips by roughly 2%. / यह बेरोजगारी दर में बदलाव और वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) की वृद्धि दर के संबंध को जोड़ता है।

qe: What characterizes a 'Command Economy'?
o: A centralized planned economic system where production, resource allocation, and prices are determined by the state
An economy dominated exclusively by private banks
e: In a command economy, state planners dictate what to produce, how to produce, and set official prices. / ऐसी व्यवस्था जहां क्या, कितना और किस कीमत पर उत्पादन करना है, यह पूरी तरह केंद्रीय सरकार तय करती है।

qe: What is an 'Externality' in microeconomic market failure analysis?
o: A cost or benefit incurred by an uninvolved third party as an unintended consequence of economic activity
e: Pollution is a negative externality; scientific research and immunization generate positive externalities. / किसी उत्पादन या उपभोग गतिविधि का वह प्रभाव जो बिना किसी कीमत के तीसरे पक्ष को भुगतना या प्राप्त होता है।

qe: What does 'Skewflation' mean in price analysis?
o: Skewed price inflation concentrated predominantly in one or a few specific commodity sectors while others remain stable
Uniform deflation across all industrial sectors
e: Skewflation describes episodic inflationary spikes restricted to narrow segments (like food items) while non-food sectors remain soft. / जब पूरी अर्थव्यवस्था में नहीं, बल्कि केवल कुछ चुनिंदा वस्तुओं (जैसे दालों या प्याज) में असामान्य महंगाई देखी जाती है।

qe: What does 'EBITDA' measure on a corporate financial statement?
qh: 'EBITDA' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization, evaluating core operational profitability
e: EBITDA evaluates baseline cash operational earnings by stripping away capital structure, taxation, and non-cash write-offs. / यह कंपनी की परिचालन दक्षता को मापने वाला पैमाना है जो ब्याज, कर और मूल्यह्रास घटाने से पहले का लाभ दिखाता है।

qe: What is the 'Initial Margin' required in derivative contracts?
qh: ट्रेडिंग में 'इनिशियल मार्जिन' (Initial Margin) क्या है?
o: The upfront collateral deposit required by the clearing house to initiate and hold an open leveraged position
e: Initial margin acts as a performance bond protecting the exchange against intraday counterparty default risk. / लेवरेज्ड पोजीशन खोलने के लिए एक्सचेंज या ब्रोकर के पास जमा की जाने वाली शुरुआती न्यूनतम जमानत राशि।

qe: Which Indian public sector organization provides 'Export Credit Insurance' against commercial and political payment risks?
qh: कौन सा संगठन भारतीय निर्यातकों को 'निर्यात ऋण बीमा' प्रदान करता है?
o: ECGC (Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India)
e: ECGC provides insurance covers to Indian exporters against non-payment by overseas buyers. / ECGC भारतीय निर्यातकों को विदेशी खरीदारों द्वारा भुगतान न किए जाने के जोखिमों से सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है।

qe: In a pure 'Floating' exchange rate regime, what determines the relative value of a currency?
qh: 'बाजार निर्धारित' विनिमय दर प्रणाली में, मुद्रा का मूल्य किसके द्वारा तय किया जाता है?
o: Unrestricted forces of foreign exchange market demand and supply
Daily administrative fixing by the Ministry of Finance
Statutory gold parity set by the IMF
e: Market clearing demand and supply for export receipts, import payments, and capital flows determine market exchange rates. / विदेशी मुद्रा बाजार में मांग और आपूर्ति की बाजार शक्तियां विनिमय दर तय करती हैं।

qe: Why does India operate a 'Managed Float' (Dirty Float) exchange rate regime?
qh: भारत 'मैनेज्ड फ्लोट' विनिमय दर प्रणाली का पालन क्यों करता है?
o: To eliminate the necessity for foreign exchange reserves
To rigidly peg the rupee to gold bullion
To bar foreign investors from holding rupees
To allow broad market determination while permitting RBI interventions to curb destabilizing volatility
e: The rupee floats freely, but RBI actively buys or sells dollars to smooth speculative volatility without setting fixed targets. / विनिमय दर बाजार द्वारा तय होती है, लेकिन अत्यधिक उतार-चढ़ाव को नियंत्रित करने के लिए RBI समय-समय पर हस्तक्षेप करता है।

qe: What transactions create commercial demand for foreign currencies (e.g. US Dollars) in the domestic Indian market?
qh: भारतीय विदेशी मुद्रा बाजार में अमेरिकी डॉलर की 'मांग' निम्नलिखित में से किसके कारण उत्पन्न होती है?
o: Overseas tourists visiting domestic tourist centers
Domestic importers settling payments for foreign merchandise and energy
Foreign venture capitalists funding domestic startups
e: Indian importers, outbound travelers, and outward investors must sell rupees to acquire dollars to pay overseas counterparties. / विदेशी वस्तुओं के आयातकों और विदेश यात्रा करने वाले नागरिकों को भुगतान के लिए डॉलर खरीदने की आवश्यकता होती है।

qe: Under the 'Liberalised Remittance Scheme' (LRS), what is the annual limit permitted to resident individuals by the RBI?
qh: 'उदारीकृत प्रेषण योजना' (LRS) के तहत, भारतीय निवासी विशेष अनुमति के बिना सालाना कितनी राशि विदेश भेज सकते हैं?
e: Resident individuals are allowed to remit up to $250,000 per financial year for permissible current and capital account transactions. / RBI द्वारा प्रत्येक वित्तीय वर्ष में निवासियों को 2,50,000 अमेरिकी डॉलर तक विदेश भेजने की छूट दी गई है।

qe: What does the 'Nominal Effective Exchange Rate' (NEER) track?
qh: 'नाममात्र प्रभावी विनिमय दर' (NEER) का क्या महत्व है?
o: The trade-weighted geometric average of bilateral exchange rates against a basket of currencies
The prime lending rate of commercial banks
e: NEER evaluates whether a currency is appreciating or depreciating against an entire basket of major trading partner currencies. / यह प्रमुख व्यापारिक साझेदारों की मुद्राओं की एक बास्केट के मुकाबले घरेलू मुद्रा का भारित औसत मूल्य दर्शाता है।
